The parking lot further distorts its charm. We went to another beach that was just as beautiful and with a lot fewer people. You just need to search a little. After all, we are on vacation. We had time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bonne plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unlike others we did not pay for parking. Beautiful beach like almost all the others. Clear water we see a lot of fish. Fairly calm water and sheltered from the wind

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A voir une fois pas plus
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pretty beach, nothing more, very "have you seen me": you can find equally beautiful ones a few kilometers further. Exorbitant parking price: €20 per day!! Staying in the neighborhood: no basic necessities store (bakery for example), no shop (impossible to buy a postcard there...), difficult walks because of unsafe roads... Seen it once, won't go back. I have been staying in Corsica every summer for 10 years and there is so much better, more intimate, more equipped, more financially affordable, more accessible to "everyone"

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Très jolie et agréable plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very pretty beach with white sand. Clear and warm water for September. You can find huts there. Please note: no parking, you must park along the road. If you park near the beach, you will have problems leaving because two cars have great difficulty passing each other.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: La plus belle plage de Corse!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: it was just magnificent. Right next to Porto-Vecchio. We loved it. The beach, the fine sand, the crystal clear water, everything was just magnificent. Parking not far away.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Très belle plage mais touristique
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sublime beach but crowded with tourists. However, it is worth the detour! Remember to park upstream as there is no parking

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magnifique
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach visited late in the afternoon. Great shaded car. Turquoise water, transparent and warm, fine sand. We parked on the side of the road (10 minutes walk), it's worth it because otherwise parking in restaurants for €20 (deductible from the meal if you eat there). There were few people on this late September afternoon ☀️

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sublime
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Superb beach, turquoise water... It's paradise. It's an unmissable beach, a must-see! Advice: Avoid July and August because of the overcrowding and arrive early in the morning if you want to park close to the sea and free.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Parking payant
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach but we can regret the parking which has become paying (3.5€). Motorhomes can park overnight for €10.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Un cadre magnifique
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is worth it with its parking lots 500 meters from the water but what a panoramic view once you arrive. A white sand beach, turquoise water, the mountains and pine forests in the background, everything you need to have a great day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magnifique, incontournable
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Probably the most beautiful beach in Corsica! Fine sand, turquoise water... who would think we are in France! Ideal with young children because there is little depth along the beach. The beach is huge, you will definitely find the ideal place to put your towel. Several beach restaurants allow you to eat lunch or dinner, have an aperitif or even breakfast.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magnifique plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Large white sand beach with crystal clear waters..retaurant playa baggia opens on this beach, it has parking and the menu is exquisite

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Très jolie plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very pretty, busy beach even in September. Beach with fine sand and turquoise water. Easy access despite lack of parking space

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Plage incontournable.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You have to earn this beach because access without paid parking is practically impossible. Do not hesitate to explore the coast which offers a diversity of sites, large white sand beach, either rocky cove for lovers of magnificent seabeds, or small, very narrow steep beach surrounded by rocks reminiscent of dolmens.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Une plage de rêve
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Easy access and above all a very large free shaded car park just a stone's throw from the beach. Be careful, there are a few paid parking lots before you arrive at the beach. Don't fall into the trap! Otherwise, a beach with clear, turquoise waters. Fine sand and a breathtaking view. Take a walk on this beach to the famous gray rocks which resemble the Seychelles and behind discover Tamaricciu beach! An enchantment! We don't expect to see this. It's like Virgin Gorda in the Caribbean in the British Virgin Islands! Go for it! Run there!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Belle plage mais trop de monde
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach but too many people.  The water is translucent, watch out for algae. Good swimming. Large parking lot and possibility to eat on site.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Une plage magnifique
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The transparent, warm, turquoise water is just pure happiness. Possibility of parking or along the road.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Plage magnifique
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Magnificent beach with crystal clear water. I recommend arriving via the Tamaricciu path rather than via the car park which reveals a more charming side of the beach, always take a left on the path.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eau magnifique
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water is clear and a magnificent turquoise. The beach has white sand. However, all this magical landscape described by the postcards is spoiled by the very significant presence of Posidonia present both in the water and on the beach. Well aware that this is a protected species and necessary for the survival of the beaches, they invade the space and make the beach and swimming much less pleasant. Listening to the people around us, I heard the same feeling. Is there not a way to "clean" the beach even if it is an algae or plant to be exact...We discovered this beach at the beginning of September and were able to park without difficulty in the free parking lot. However the beach is not very big and there are a lot of people, I don't dare imagine in peak season... The beach is also very encroached with private payotte beaches for a coastline that wants to be "wild", it's a shame.....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sable blanc mais Noir de monde
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I had been praised so much about these beaches of Palombaggia...we were disappointed...Inaccessible in August very long and bumpy road to get there crowded parking lot In short, it is better to choose smaller and less famous beaches that are just as pretty, the names of which I will not mention so as not to find the crowds there next year...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradisiaque
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A heavenly beach, umbrella pines, transparent turquoise blue water and luckily not many people

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Belle plage mais pas la best
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's a beautiful beach with pretty colors but lots of pieces of plastic in the water. Too bad for the many fish present in the water. We found free parking under the pines, the path is chaotic but it's okay. For us it's not the most beautiful but on the podium nonetheless. The most worrying being water pollution 😭

reviewsWithKeywords.title: La vérité sur Palombaggia
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Palombaggia is no longer what it was. In the middle of summer, it has become a primarily commercial beach, with parking for... 20 euros please!!! (2020 influence?) You will find a restaurant, a private beach and dozens, even hundreds of sun loungers spread out everywhere. Masses of people gathered together who believe they are seeing the best of Corsica when they are being made to pay a high price for a distorted site. All with background music and waiters running around. If you want to find more calm, cleanliness and authenticity, go further south. The emblematic beach that we show you on postcards with an umbrella pine (which unfortunately no longer exists) is in fact that of Tamaricciu. Make no mistake.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tante spiagge magnifiche
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When talking about the beaches of the Porto Vecchio - Palombaggia coast, we must distinguish carefully given their number. In fact, there are many bays and even more access points to the sea, almost all with free parking on the street. The common denominator is the transparency of the seabed and the colors of the sea. The tip of Acciaghju and especially the opposite end of Tamaricciu are worth visiting, with the island of rocks with a deep seabed suitable for snorkelling.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Déçue ...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I am very disappointed by this beach, certainly the setting is heavenly like all the beaches in Corsica but this one is very narrow it is difficult to put your towel down in August without being on top of each other. To park, do not take the paid parking lots, you have to continue and you will find a fairly large free parking lot. I think that to appreciate the place you have to favor the morning or the evening.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magnifique plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach in southern Corsica Turquoise water and very long beach Attention very quickly filled ++++

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Le paradis sur terre
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Turquoise water, fine sand, and dream decor. The pleasure of swimming in a postcard. Heaven on earth

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in Corsica!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is definitely one of the most gorgeous beaches in Corsica - and one of the longest! Perfect turquoise water and white sand. There are a few bars on the beach where you get snacks (even a proper lunch but a bit pricey), ice cream and cocktails. In addition the beach is supervised by lifeguards. Tipp: be there early (at approximately 9:30 am) to get one of the rare parking spots near the beach! If you are too late you won’t get a parking spot and you have to walk down a road for 15 minutes (imagine walking the road uphill after the beach day)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Très bon restaurant
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very good restaurant where the preconceptions of mediocre beach restaurants disappear. Very careful dishes and magnificent setting.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Un peu déçue
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Yes, perfect turquoise water and fine white sand but very large beach with lots of people, water not that warm, a little disappointed I expected better

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Une des plus belles
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach with free or paid parking with shower, lots of people on the left part of the beach in summer, but more space and fewer people on the right part..follow signs for KALLISTE diving and restaurant at Chez Pierre.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Journée plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach with turquoise water. No difficulty in accessing it (free parking but come early otherwise other paid parking lots at 3.50 for the day, close to the beach). Negative point: a lot of people on the sand and therefore little space already at 11 a.m.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A ne pas rater
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A magnificent beach, translucent water and turquoise backgrounds. Don't forget your masks and snorkels: there are plenty of fish! Paid parking (€5 cash required)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superbes
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Superb beaches, coves, turquoise and warm waters, huts Plan a budget for parking and fins, snorkel masks

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tres belle plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach: fine sand and turquoise water Gentle slope ideal with children And a bar to refresh yourself and buy ice cream which is rare in Corsica. Difficult to park.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: après midi plage aout 2020
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A pretty beach with very beautiful trees, but spoiled by private restaurants and private beaches, lots of people, boats, far from being the most beautiful in Corsica.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Belle plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach lined with umbrella pines, fine sand, turquoise water, magnificent! Paid parking in a shaded location.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Journée plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, although very busy! It is better to arrive early.... and not get stuck for parking...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Plage exceptionnelle mais parking inaccessible
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is exceptional but it is a shame that the parking lot is inaccessible due to lack of sufficient spaces. After several kilometers traveled, not being able to access one of the most beautiful beaches on the island of beauty is very frustrating.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: sans plus
reviewsWithKeywords.text: too many people few places to put your towel too touristy there are such beautiful beaches and many fewer people restaurants on the beach very expensive

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice and picturesque,  but busy. Parking can be an issue. Difficult to get a table at the resto.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Parfait ❤
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ideal beach, white sand, turquoise water, pine trees, rocks, what more could you ask for? Happiness is here 👌👍

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bel endroit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Magnificent beach but very busy depending on the location. Go to a place called I Pini to access free parking and a slightly less busy place. You will find Julien's hut to drink a mojito and eat a croque croque-monsieur with ease.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Plage Splendide !!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It has become my favorite beach!!! For its turquoise, transparent water and magnificent landscape! For young children or couples this place is perfect!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bella spiaggia di sabbia fine
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Palombaggia beach is very long and even in the heart of August we didn't find too many people which is very pleasant. The water is crystal clear and a very light blue because the sand is white and fine. The only flaw is having closed off all access to the pine forest that runs along the beautiful Palombaggia with barbed iron. There are some private villas set in the pine forest and you can see that this splendid green nature... has become the prerogative of a few wealthy people and therefore you can enjoy the beach and the sea but not the shade of the beautiful pine trees. If you will stay for a long time it is better to bring an umbrella.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magnifique... mais victime de son succès
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is truly magnificent. It is large with fine sand and turquoise water. Free parking on Saturdays. On the other hand, a lot of people in August...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved it even though it was a little crowded. Ideal with children and snorkel mask. Paid parking unless you park on the street

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sable fin et eau turquoise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sea is magnificent. Clear, turquoise waters. A real little paradise. Downsides: narrow and very busy beach. Paid parking: €20 for one and €30 for another. Deductible parking rate if you eat at the restaurant. Otherwise, park up along the road and walk a bit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magique
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very very good beach with its turquoise and rocky water. Gorgeous ! Its white sand dazzles your eyes. No need to go to Tahiti to dream!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Belle plage (comme tout le monde le sait), MAIS...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lots of people. Plan to go there early in the morning. Furthermore, the beach is not very wide, its size has been reduced by half in 20 years due to rising water levels (global warming, etc.), and the most accessible parking lot is *monstrously* expensive (€20 per space!). In short, a must during a trip to Corsica, but in the long run prefer quieter beaches.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Très agréable, belle eau, grand parking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We enjoyed Palombaggia this summer, with a one-year-old baby, in the shade of a rock, at the end of the day. We recommend the evening, swimming is very pleasant!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A MUST
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For us, this is the most beautiful beach in Europe. Cristal clear water, fine white sands, and - if you walk a bit away from the crowds that glue together close to the parking lots - with enough space for you and your family to spend a beautiful quiet day at the beach. Attention though: there is not a lot of shadow, one or two sunshades are mandatory!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nel 2020, a mio giudizio, la migliore
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is always a high level competition between Palombaggia, Santa Giuglia, Rondinara and Sperone. This year in my opinion, Palombaggia has something more. Definitely perfect water for everyone, from snorkelers to younger children. Very large, with an obvious possibility of "distancing", unlike Santa Giulia, and certainly well served. Fundamental note, if you follow the road from Portovecchio along the route de Piccovagia clockwise, the first detour to the beach takes you to the car park in the northern part. Which is free.. ;-)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Toller, sauberer Strand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean, well-maintained beach with dining options. White sand with crystal clear water. Easily accessible by car and with parking facilities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Splendide
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Paid parking €4 to access this famous beach (July 2020 price). Very beautiful but there are so many other beaches as pretty, or even prettier, and with free access. It’s the selfie beach 😜. And fame has a price.🙃

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Le paradis
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My favorite! No seaweed, several huts to drink a coffee or a Pietra....turquoise water, paradise....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superbe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach has two or three access points. On the east side you can park for 4 euros then access to the beach about 400 m away. Restaurant also with private parking. The beach is long and magnificent with its turquoise colored and transparent waters. Not to be missed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sublime
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach, the water is turquoise, we had an excellent afternoon! There are also water activities like jet skiing, paddle boarding, and towed buoys!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Jolie plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach, pretty but lots of people. The car park near the beach being full we had to park at the top of the access road, go far for young children.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Venir tôt
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Magnificent beach, we can't say the opposite, but you have to come early because there are a lot of people.....Paid parking but like all the beaches in the surrounding area....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach lives up to its reputation as one of the best in Europe.....crystal clear water, white sands, easy access.....highly recommended!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Another nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very long beach, with several entrances, some close to the beach, others probably quite a walk. We were late, so could park (for free) very close, however it looked like it had been quite a lot more busy and therefore longer walks). Beach is sandy, white, water blue and warm, like most Corsican beaches.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Très belle plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great place. Free parking. We arrived around 10 a.m. Not many people in the (free) parking lot. Several cabins to eat or have a drink. Clean beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: très belle plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the beach is easy to access. Parking is free and shaded under the pines and pine forest. possibility of having lunch on site (bar-restaurant) and doing activities of all kinds: diving, paddle, ...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Plage de rêve.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sublime beach with several restaurants which offer deckchairs. A little crowded...but the site is heavenly.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Plage au goût de paradis
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Palombaggia beach has nothing to envy of Caribbean beaches. White sand, crystal clear water,...everything is there except 3 degrees less in terms of water temperature. Worth seeing and stay there for at least an afternoon. Be careful, the bar-restaurants are quite expensive! (8.5 euros for a corona and 7.5 euros for a 25 cl pietra, the price of which is 4 euros maximum in towns and villages).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Une clarté magique !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Palombaggia beach is one of the most magnificent jewels of Corsica. The water is incredibly clear, even with a depth of 3m. The beach is certainly a little narrow but allows the space to be slightly restricted, therefore tourists. It is also very well maintained and very clean. The not-so-shy fish come and peck at the legs when launching into the water and amuse young people and adults alike! There are also several restaurants along the beach which gives an air of paradise to this already magnificent beach. Several paid parking lots (inexpensive for the day, around 3-5€) are located upstream of the beach and are connected directly by Corsican backwoods paths to the beach. Variety of landscapes guaranteed!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Très belle plage, peut être surestimée...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very pretty beach, practical for children because you can walk very far. Crystal clear water, like almost everywhere in southern Corsica. But wild parking (to avoid the 20€...), numerous beach restaurants which to our taste completely distort the place, and above all, the beach is very narrow... Few people in 2020, probably a pandemic effect.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magnifique plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fairly fine sand beach, not too crowded. No presence of algae. Easy to access thanks to parking (4€ per day).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: L’une des plus belles plages
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s true that this beach is beautiful. There are certainly people there but if you walk a little you won't be stuck with the others. Paid parking 20€ but deducted from your bill if you eat at the restaurant (provided you keep the ticket). Otherwise, to park elsewhere, you will need to arrive before 10 a.m.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: belle journée
reviewsWithKeywords.text: very beautiful beach. not very crowded (covid requires?) calm and absolute charm. the turquoise blue water is ideal for children (snorkeling or swimming)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magnifique
reviewsWithKeywords.text: All the charm of this beach is above all the fact of swimming with fish at the water's edge, in transparent water. The children loved it! As well as being able to prolong the pleasure with snorkeling just opposite which takes you swimming to discover fish.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Détente et soleil sous un décors de carte postale
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have had the chance to discover. Of course, it remains a public beach with a lot of people but the water is magnificent, the sand is fine and it is Corsican weather. Not ideal for snorkeling, more beach relaxation and sun

reviewsWithKeywords.title: La plus belle plage du monde !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Over the past 7 years we have visited many beaches but we always come back to this beach because for us it is undoubtedly the most beautiful beach in the world! The water is crystal clear. The white sand is very fine. The huts are nice. The free, shaded parking is very pleasant. I recommend this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: La plus belle plage de Corse du Sud
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is incredible, especially on the northernmost part towards the red rocks, the water is really turquoise and clear, the sand is white... It's hard to believe we're in France! I prefer Palombaggia to Santa Giulia because it's wilder (less boats and jets!). Plus no difficulty in parking since the parking lots are free at the start of summer 2020! Will it last???

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magnifique
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in Corsica, turquoise blue water which has a Caribbean feel, a must-visit place if you are passing through the area!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice view, White Sand, too many people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach with white sand and great view to turquose sea. Restaurants and parking (20€) near.  Lot of company, too. Good for kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superbe plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Magnificent beach, easy parking, superb location, it feels like a lagoon, children can walk far away and the spot is superb for taking photos Few people at this time at the end of June

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Le paradis
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most beautiful beach in wild Corsica with turquoise water and white sand Why go to the Caribbean or Maldives when you have Palombaggia

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superbe !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful, peaceful beach with crystal clear waters! Red rocks at the water's edge giving the appearance of a deserted cove. Easy access with paid parking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Belle plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful and long beach of fine sand, there are several portions, so it is easy to find a place to relax. The parking lot is easy to access

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superbissime!! Un vrai petit paradis
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very large parking lot, still free in June. The beach of fine white sand is very pretty, very charming with its turquoise-reflecting water. No waves, ideal for children. Red rocks bordering several coves and large pine trees overlooking the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Le paradis
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Magnificent beach of fine sand and turquoise water! Embellished with red rocks which give an exceptional charm! There is a charge for parking (4€) but at least you park in the shade and close by, which is nice with a young child!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice...but
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice..but close to sunset tons of mosquitos are everwhere. Clean water and white sand, but beach is not so wide, so beware of the peack (and most crowded) hrs...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradisiaque
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clear water like a swimming pool, not many people, exceptional. Clean beach, free parking at this time (access at the end of the palombaggia towards the hut).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superbe!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Breathtaking landscapes, turquoise water... Just superb! And what's more, we were treated to an almost deserted beach... the dream!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Une vue une plage paradisiaques
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Heaven on earth. Translucent turquoise blue water. Fine sand with umbrella pines. In addition at the beginning of June 2020 no one

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bel endroit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very pretty beach, heavenly at the beginning of June where the beach is deserted after confinement, beautiful place but I think that in summer it must be tough. Parking 4 euros (not currently activated)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Le paradis
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My favorite, magnificent beach, however in high season you have to plan to go there in the morning (from 10 a.m. it is full), there are toilets and free parking nearby (you have to go past the paid parking lot)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Le rêve
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Palombaggia beach, crystal clear water, a clean sandy beach, two restaurants on the water's edge, an idyllic setting, the rocks that stand out from the edge give the appearance of an island at the end of the world. You will keep an unforgettable memory!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superbe plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Magnificent beach with crystal clear turquoise water. Big enough to take a walk. Paid parking 10€ with 5€ restaurant credit...many people park on the street and walk. A few restaurants with sea views. No public toilets.  We went in September so not too busy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Demasiados autos en el parking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: full of cars, it is best to reserve a table in Cala di Lume, to make sure they let the car pass, because if not you have to leave it far away. It is a beach that does not stand out for anything, I don't see anything special about it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradisiaque
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Magnificent beach which still resists developers, parking is not easy but seeing the color of the water we forget.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Merveilleux
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An endless beach of fine sand where the crystal clear sea has reflections of turquoise and different blues to deep blues What a desire is to immerse yourself in this magnificent water and come out to walk on the sand!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superbe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach lined with maritime pines. The best thing is to park in a restaurant parking lot, eat (super fair price) and stay a few hours on this long and beautiful beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Surcotée
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Of course the beach with its turquoise and clear waters is magnificent but what a shame that to access it you have to pay €5 for parking

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Belle plage, site agréable
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We really enjoyed this long fine sand beach and what surrounds it. The beach is not easy to find coming from Ajaccio, the path is long and winding. Suggestion: walk up to restaurants with names like "Beach Something" and park there. If you have at least a coffee, you will be left in peace for the duration of your swim, especially if you arrive in the morning, there is plenty of room for cars. Beautiful, clean and public beach (i.e. not sequestered by an establishment). Wide enough for a row of deck chairs and umbrellas and a generous strip for those who don't want to pay a fortune for this service and are content with a towel on the sand. The proximity of restaurants is very useful when it's lunch time, and the prices are not prohibitive. A few personal watercraft rentals in one area, but disciplined enough not to spoil the swimmers' experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: La plus belle plage du sud de la Corse
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Kilometers of white sand, transparent water, colors of the Caribbean Sea, excellent restaurants... you are on the most beautiful beach in southern Corsica. Discover this magnificent beach which takes place on either side of the protected site of Tamaricciu, you will have the impression of touching paradise.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Merveilleux
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beach in the middle of nature, magnificent landscape I recommend without hesitation. Easy access and parking nearby

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mooie strand met restaurants
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful, gently sloping beach. Fine sand. Some needles. Nice restaurant for lunch. No dinner.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacances
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is how we can design a vacation: splendid beach turquoise water fish within reach (if you are quick!!) the beaches of Corsica are magnificent but this one is worth the detour

reviewsWithKeywords.title: superbe plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Magnificent beach which well deserves its title of most beautiful beach in Europe! Surrounded by orange-colored rock. Not to be missed. Regarding parking: there are several with different prices. We took the 1st: 3.50 euros with shower included, the parking lot is guarded. It's reasonable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach with gentle shelving in the water so safe. Busy than some other beaches. You will have to pay to park but close and lots of it in shade. One of my favourite in the south. Small number Bars and restaurants.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Découverte
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Superb beach which reminds us that the Caribbean is within our reach. Beauty of the environment, turquoise color of the marine waters at 28°C where it is easy to observe the marine fauna and flora in 3 meters of water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Le paradis
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is exceptional. Not very wide with a magnificent view. The water is turquoise and crystal clear. Breathtaking colors. We were racing in the Caribbean. You can see lots of fish there. On the other hand, access is complicated I think in high season.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Exceptionnel

reviewsWithKeywords.text: P.'s beach was our highlight in the south. Clear water, no algae, few waves and gentle entry. For snorkelers there are many stones where the fish live. The only negative point is the path. We didn't find it at first because most of the paths lead through private hotels and clubs and you're not allowed to walk through them... so all we had to do was walk along the street until we found a way down a flight of stairs. However, it was worth the effort!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Une superbe plage

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Le rêve

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Plage incroyable !!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Très belle plage mais victime de son succès!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For access, two possibilities, if you come before 11 a.m., you can park at the side of the road, otherwise paid parking near the beach (5 euros). Then you access the beach passing under umbrella pines. The beach is really beautiful with translucent water, fine sand and orange-colored rocks. The big downside is obviously the overcrowding of this beach which is reminiscent of the beaches of the Var in July/August. Part of the beach is occupied by two huts and deckchairs. I think we should favor this beach in the off-season.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Grande plage de sable blanc
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pretty sandy beach, turquoise water, arrive early to park for free at the bottom near the beach along the road, otherwise paid parking further away.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tres beau
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have been to this beach twice. Parking is 5 euros (in September) near the beach and further up the road it is free but at your risk for the car. The first time we were mixed because there was a lot of seaweed on the beach and in the water we couldn't really swim. The 2nd, on the weekend, was much better because there was no algae and so it was heavenly. If you want deckchairs there are private deckchairs with service between 18 and 25 euros per day or free deckchairs which we still rent without service and free installation between 15 and 20 eutos per day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: As beautiful as the pictures
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beach even better because we were there at the end of the season. Crystal clear waters and powderwhite sand.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Belle plage, certes
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Attracted by the notoriety of this beach we made a significant detour (2 hours) to get there. Beautiful beach certainly lined with pine trees and with Polynesian colors but several drawbacks: overcrowding, feeling of unease seeing the commercialism surrounding (temple merchants), price of parking (4€), and this nationalist flag (blindfolded terrorist crouching in shooting position) which floats above the luxury hut... funny atmosphere welcome, which contrasts with that found everywhere else in Corsica, open and friendly. In short, pretty beach but not exceptional, overrated reputation. The ingredients (white sand, color and lagoon warmth, dotted with a few rocks) can be found in many other places in Corsica.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Splendide plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: How can I tell you... Fine sand beach, transparent and turquoise sea, dream setting...the island of beauty lives up to its name The only downside is finding a parking space and that again in September

You can use expensive loungers here (€25 per person + a beach service of €5 per order) or lie down as normal with your parasol and mattress next to you... There are also beach restaurants and a small kiosk at the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tranquillité
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful little beach and a straw hut where the people are friendly. The only drawback is that you have to park for €5.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Jolie plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very pretty beach of fine sand with beautiful rocks. Preferably go there in the morning, clear water with fewer people and crystal clear water. To avoid paying for parking, follow the road to the end.. The last parking lot is more ready and also free....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: vacances
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach...but...paid parking...lots of people. little space, too bad this beach deserves better.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Très belle plage mais..
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A very beautiful beach renowned in Corsica. We went there as a couple. We were not disappointed, the beach is sublime, the water is turquoise and warm for the month of September. The problem is that the beach is overcrowded in September... I dare to imagine in July or August. But it's still worth going there for its beauty and a romantic swim.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Zo mooi als op foto!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach with crystal clear water. We stayed here for a few days at the end of August and it was very pleasant. Not cheap, €5 for parking and if you want a parasol with 2 sun loungers you pay €32. There was a toilet and beach shower. And you could eat very well there. What more could you want!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful as well as smelly
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Mixed feelings about this beach... it was so much I heard and read of it that perhaps I expected a lot... my disappointment was when swimming towards the rocks side and there was this awful smell of decay seaweeds... absolutely dreadful and it actually turned me down with regards of my opinion about the beach... apart of that beautiful scenery!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Trop trop belle plage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is our favorite beach! Many beaches are beautiful in Corsica, all of them! but Palombaggia is really nice and not that crowded. We always find a good place there. It is clean, beautiful sand, rocks for diving on the left, rock piles for swimming and discovering the depths with a mask and snorkel. The view is magnificent. And for those who want to be "jet setters" there are bars and music on the right

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A VOIR

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Une plage incontournable

The wild side is preserved, restaurants and boats are not spread out all along this superb beach. Go there and admire!!!

reviews.title: Do not park here see the text “Parcheggio-Auto-Campeggio I PINI”.
reviews.text: We visited several sections of this beach. In the southern part, the “La Plage de la Folaca” area is highly recommended. You park at the top of the road and walk down a sandy road. The sand is white and the water is beautiful like in the Caribbean. However, when it blows strongly, the waves are very high and the beach becomes a little narrower as a result.The northern area is called “Le Craquelin Beach” – the beach is very nice as above. We parked in the parking lot “Parcheggio-Auto-Campeggio I PINI”. In the rear area is a parking space for campers and in the front area beach guests are allowed to park for 4 €/day. However, the path from the parking lot to the beach leads through “a toilet under pine trees”. Handkerchiefs and heaps of feces (not from dogs) are everywhere.

reviews.title: The best beach in the south
reviews.text: Definitely the best in Corsica.Three parking spaces at different prices and one free as long as there is space, all in the pine forest. There is a bar/restaurant on the white sandy beach surrounded by reddish rocks with little space and then there is a whole very long part of free white sandy beach, rather flat.There's plenty of room for everyone without getting together Coarse white sand clean, no algae, no jellyfish, but fish, fantastic seabed gently denigrates towards the 'high water but it takes quite a while to get there. On the horizontal you can see two islands and some boats moored.Quiet, polite people no cell phones or loud radios, no noisy people screaming, no garbage.The water is clear, you can see the bottom and the temperature was ideal.Ventilated, but not too much, there are no high waves.However, I recommend you bring an umbrella, a hat and sunscreen because with the wind you do not realize you are sunbathing.On the beach I saw two dogs. One in the water with a leash as it should always be if there are other people and the other quiet and obedient under his umbrella away from others on the beach.Arriving from the parking lots is convenient on perfectly groomed paths in the pine forest.The bathrooms to be an establishment were clean equipped with paper, soap and there were not the usual pestilential smells that you usually smell near the sea. They are free and people leave them as the bathrooms should be: in good condition and decent for everyone. I thought this beach was overrated, but after seeing several of them in Corsica, I can say that this one is not forgotten and you will want to go back.

reviews.title: Attention paid parking!! Really bad.

reviews.text: We had planned to go for a sunset walk on the beach, but the weather was Covered, so we did not see the Palombaggia at its best.The water nevertheless remains translucent and the beach must be beautiful on a clear day and a real sun. We'll go back!

reviews.title: Fab experience!
reviews.text: Definitely worth the hype! Very pretty and the bay is open so when there's wind you get waves to frolic in! Rustic with very few boats or water activity vehicles. So much space and the geography is incredible. All those beautiful pine trees!  Water very pretty. A couple of bars at the far end. Downside: Limited Parking is a nightmare so either get there early or find a spot on the street and walk in. PS - Avoid Santa Giulia beach and focus on this one instead - SG is a thin strip of sand, heaps of seaweed along the shore (I mean, easy to clean up if they bothered) and calm, limpid, non exciting water. Way too busy, even mid week in September. Way more parking at SG but we were unimpressed.

reviews.text: Beautiful beach, clear water. Beautiful. The only downside, the parking lot. We were just passing through, stopped for a little while. This man (35 years old) was hateful to us. There was no one in this car park, only campers who paid the day before (so at the entrance) to sleep. When we arrived at 9:30 there was no one at the till. This man was really dismissive and yet I am not adept at negative criticism usually.

reviews.title: simply stunning
reviews.text: The most stunning beach with white sand and turquoise water.  Take snorkels and head to the rocky area at the end and you will see lots of fish.  We loved that people took their dogs to the beach and watching them play in the water.  The beach is immaculately clean and everyone respects taking litter to the bins.  We seem to be mosquito magnets so sun downers after 6pm did require a bit of perseverance and a lot of deet!  Even though it was busy In August, there was always enough space to lay out towels and we loved that there was no music blasting anywhere.

reviews.title: Palombaggia in the evening
reviews.text: Nobody comes in at night.Only well-dressed night owls who come for dinner or a drink on one of the chic beachfront terraces rub shoulders with this large and beautiful beach, its small wild boars and its many and voracious mosquitoes.

reviews.title: rude waiters
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and beautiful sea, too bad for the waiters / bartenders very rude and annoyed... for the beach and the sea nothing to say.... a paradise

reviews.title: Back epr a visit and understand how it has changed...  TOO CHANGED, TOO BAD!!
reviews.text: I "returned" to Corsica after many years, a site. I knew the island well, but it has changed, really a lot. Once the access to the beaches was very simple, you parked and got off. Now they have lotted a lot, the diving road ruined by high walls, you can no longer see the coast, paid parking everywhere. And it is better to pay.... August a delirium, too many people, to forget. The southwest coast .... no... better to rent a boat to visit it, Porto Vecchio always beautiful but I repeat, forget it in August.  For the rest... beaches where you pay for parking and nothing else, where now you find the usual imbeciles with rackets and balloon .. is not as wild as I knew and hoped to find, improved ferries but... if I lived in Corsica in August I would leave.In August rent a boat, it's better!!!  Change month even better.

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the southeast of the island
reviews.text: Admittedly without a car, you won't get to this beach so easily, time you should also plan something depending on where you arrive ..BUT the journey is worth it! Very clean turquoise blue water, shallow sloping - so also suitable for small children & hardly any current or waves as it is located in a relatively wind-protected bay. We haven't had any jellyfish in our 10 days. Parking has it right behind the dunes, if you manage between 9am-10am you get free parking quite far to the front of the sea (you still have to walk a little bit), if you arrive a little later there is still enough in the back & for €3 a day there is even a guarded section, with lots of trees/shade places so that the car does not heat up so much until the evening ...From there it is about 10min relaxed between trees & dune landscape to the beach, another 5min walk to get away from the first “crowds” & then you have complete peace & quiet & your nearest neighbor only in 10-15m distance 🙌The food at the beach bars is simple but good & inexpensive, friendly they are also :) Have fun & enjoy it 🌞

reviews.title: Fine sand and turquoise water
reviews.text: At the end of the day, between 5pm and 8pm we easily found room to put our towels down. Once the crowd is gone, the Mood is very pleasant, the restaurants offer pizzas for dinner on the beach. Overall we preferred this beach rather than that of santa Giulia whose strip of sand is too narrow to accommodate the mass of tourists in August.

reviews.title: Annoying water sports enthusiasts
reviews.text: It's midsummer, there's a lot of people on the beach. Overall, it is acceptable from this point of view.In Corsica we were on other beaches that I liked better, eg exactly on the opposite side: fewer people, more bars (eg Cargese).However, what annoys me extremely are the - although 500m away - very loud motorboats and jet skis. Laughing children on the beach are 1000 times more pleasant than these totally overpowered ... water sports enthusiasts!

reviews.title: THE REAL BEAUTIFUL SEA🌊
reviews.text: This for us was the first beach we visited, needless to say we were fascinated by the colors of the sea and nature.We arrived early in the morning around nine o'clock to be able to find free parking just a few minutes from the beach. After a short walk we reached a part of the beach where there were 10 equipped umbrellas at a price of 30€ (2 sunbeds-1 umbrella) at cheaper than the other beaches further on. The sea had a really nice clear color and in the morning you can also see the fish.HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach

There are bars and establishments, lots of free beach, there is everything and it is beautiful. Must-see places.

reviews.title: Best beach in Europe ? Not really.
reviews.text: Due to the award of best beach in Europe we drove one way from Ajaccio to this beach (about 130 km, 3 hours drive) arrived there we had to realize that it is an average beach, which was of course completely crowded although we were already there in the morning, showers are charged if you buy the bar something. Yes the water is crystal clear, but such beaches are very often found in Corsica, for us it was not of value the long way.

reviews.title: Palombagia, to flee in August
reviews.text: Flee the beach North and center, too many people in a noisy environment. Instead, head south and across the rocky beach bar. The beaches are smaller and less crowded. Parking is for a fee but acceptable

reviews.title: A little piece of paradise in Corsica! 🌊☀️
reviews.text: Palombaggia Beach is simply one of the most beautiful beaches I have had the chance to visit. Located a few kilometers from Porto-Vecchio, it offers a breathtaking natural setting: fine and clear sand, turquoise and shallow waters, umbrella pines that offer natural shade... a real postcard decor!The water is exceptionally clear, perfect for swimming, swimming or simply relaxing. Even in the middle of summer, we found a little quieter places by walking a few minutes. It is an ideal place for couples as well as families with children.The colors are amazing, especially in the late afternoon when the sun starts to come down: a real open-air show. If you love nature, the sea and Mediterranean atmospheres, this is a must.There are a few huts and restaurants nearby to eat without leaving this little piece of paradise, as well as wilder areas if you prefer absolute calm.In short, Palombaggia is the dream beach par excellence, a real favorite that I recommend without hesitation to all those who visit Southern Corsica. Plan an umbrella and arrive early if you go in high season!

reviews.text: It seems to be one of the most beautiful beaches in southern Corsica.Well it is nice and spacious but for me it has nothing extraordinary in an island that is particularly spoiled in this area.If we add to that a very narrow car access and a parking lot that is difficult to access, it is nothing other than an ambush in the middle of summer and so one piece of advice is to move on!

reviews.title: Great beach and big
reviews.text: Beautiful long beach with pebbles resembling the Seychelles… access to the parking is a little complicated and not enough space but it is worth the detour, I recommend!

reviews.title: the sea in its best essence
reviews.text: Plage de Palombaggia is very renowned and I would say rightly so. It is a wonderful place surrounded by nature. At the end of July it wasn't crowded. No negative aspects to report.

reviews.title: Beautiful but too crowded
reviews.text: A magnificent beach but you struggle to find a piece of sand to put your towel on... Better to go to the west side where there are equally beautiful beaches and plenty of space as far as the eye can see.

reviews.title: Magnificent Palombaggia beach
reviews.text: Palombaggia is one of the most beautiful beaches in Corsica. Corsica is magnificent and allows you to spend a superb vacation on beaches not invaded by deck chairs.

reviews.title: Deplorable parking organization
reviews.text: At the end of August, we wanted to stop at this beach, but the parking organization there is more than deplorable. There is a barrier which remains open and where we rush onto the path leading to the beach between 2 rows of parked vehicles even though there are no parking and vehicle removal signs. Arriving at the bottom, we are stuck and we have to go back up everything in reverse while making traffic so that all the vehicles do the same. I don't congratulate those who thought about "organization".

reviews.title: Heavenly
reviews.text: Really beautiful beach, very long, shallow and crystal clear water, one of the most beautiful views in southern Corsica, a little difficult to get there by car, you have to park first at about 500/600 m in the rather expensive car parks at the top, then you go down on foot but it's worth it

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but nothing more. Other nearby beaches are just as good. For the month of September it's packed with people. Parking paying 4 euros shameful to get to the sea.

reviews.title: A pretty beach with transparent water
reviews.text: Described as one of the most beautiful beaches in Corsica, getting there is not easy, especially if you want to go to the second part of the beach which is reached by climbing on rocks. The water is indeed transparent and clean. On the other hand, the beach is rather narrow and must be sheltered in high season. There is free parking nearby but it fills up quickly in summer.

reviews.title: Paradise beach
reviews.text: A total change of sceneryOne of the most beautiful beaches in CorsicaDon't hesitate to walk to get out of the crowd. The beach is very extensive.You have free, shaded parking at the end of the path

reviews.title: Beach with shallow depth
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach where children can play because they can walk for a very long time. The only downside is that this beach is a victim of its own success and there are a lot of people.

reviews.title: Corsica how wonderful
reviews.text: Beautiful and well-kept free beach, fine sand. It is one of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen. Free parking in the pine forest.

reviews.title: Fitness walking after swimming
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but 20 minutes walk because the parking lot fills up quickly, the outward journey is not a problem but the return is sporty. We hear jet skis all the time. Too touristy for my taste

reviews.title: Beach as well known as it is beautiful
reviews.text: When you visit such a beautiful beach you risk being repetitive, regarding the clear, crystalline sea and the soft, golden beach.In reality, everyone always carries a pleasant new sensation within themselves, which will accompany them in good memories and, perhaps, will make them return.

reviews.title: Beautiful and large sandy beach
reviews.text: Perhaps the beach I liked the most, among the most popular ones in the area. The beach is quite long and no matter how crowded there is always space. Very beautiful and crystal clear water.

reviews.title: An open-air swimming pool
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in Corsica. The water is like a swimming pool, no jellyfish, not too crowded with people. We stayed until 3 p.m. It is easy to park there nearby (large free car park 100m away), but at certain times you have to wait for a space to become available.

reviews.title: Our favorite beach!
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach, easy to access, and not overcrowded! Of all the ones we've done in the area, this one is my favorite.Parking €4 per day, good value for money

reviews.title: Large and beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful very large beach, crystal clear water and almost white beach, shallow seabed suitable for children, if you arrive early you can park for free under the pine trees

reviews.title: Paradise beach
reviews.text: Superb beach to redo very quicklyHeavenly placeThe sea is translucentWe had a nice time

reviews.title: Blue sea swimming pool beautiful beach
reviews.text: Of all the beaches in Corsica, this is my favorite, the crystal clear water is the most beautiful, even compared to that of Santa Giulia. Parking is cheaper than the other 4€ car under the pines and there is a shower. As for the sand, it is also the finest compared to other beaches. Non-crowded beach on a Sunday at 11 a.m. on 08/20. I highly recommend

reviews.title: Heavenly
reviews.text: Paradise beach. A tip: try Tuma Snack, super good and very fresh with a super friendly welcome

reviews.title: Very nice crowded beach…
reviews.text: “The” Porto-Vecchio beach!Really very beautiful, fine sand but really crowded.Parking nearby for €10.

reviews.title: Big disappointment, overrated reputation.
reviews.text: You already have to drive a lot to get to the car parks (between €10 and €20 per day depending on the car park). Then the beach is certainly very long but also very narrow, we are far from having a feeling of immensity but rather of being pressed against wooden barriers... The water is clear, it's true, but there was also black algae and the turquoise quickly becomes dark blue as soon as you move away from the edge due to the background. Although we arrived quite early in the morning, the filling was not long in coming. In the end, we find ourselves on a narrow strip of crowded sand with a panorama that is absolutely nothing extraordinary unless you have never traveled. Palombaggia beach is more beautiful seen from above than once you are there.

reviews.title: The best beach in Corsica
reviews.text: Incredible and magnificent beach, undoubtedly the best beach in Corsica. The clear water, the pine trees, the waves, there’s everything you need to have a good time!

reviews.title: Sublime but victim of its success…
reviews.text: Dream beach which a few years ago was not very busy and which has unfortunately transformed into a tourist nest...White sand, crystal clear water at over 27 degrees…But paid parking and little space to put your towel…Sad really...

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, very fine sand and crystal clear water. Beyond our expectations. We arrived before mid-August and although the beach was crowded we were fine. This is thanks to limited parking.

reviews.title: 4 star review
reviews.text: On our way from Bastia to Bonifacio we stopped at this beach because it is one of the most famous beaches of Corsica. Parking was free and on couple of minutes walk to the beach. Beach is beautiful, sand has a nice colour, water is beautiful and calm and the unique trees on the background gives it a gorgeous setting. There is no natural shade on the beach so bring something along. There are some sun beds for rental but only around 10/15 while the beach is very populair. At least that was the case on the side we where (Nord side). There is a beach bar with serves drinks and some food.

reviews.title: A natural spectacle
reviews.text: Amazing beach to say the least! Parked at the i pini campsite for €4, a few minutes on foot and you arrive at this earthly paradise of turquoise water and light sand, with the green of the pine forest behind you. Transparent water that falls gently, enormous free beach with space for everyone even in August, various refreshment points and activities to do. Absolute TOP

reviews.title: Stupendous!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, perhaps the most beautiful in Corsica. You can stay at the i Pini car park even at night for 10 euros for those with a camper. There are always clean toilets, a small bar in the car park and one on the beach. Beautiful and super clear sea, white sand beach.

reviews.title: Exceptional beach!
reviews.text: The beach is just exceptional with its crystal clear water and white sand. The umbrella pines and rocks also give the place great charm! Unmissable in Southern Corsica although parking is excessively expensive (€10) and it is practically impossible to escape in high season.

reviews.title: Beautiful tourist beach.
reviews.text: Beach where the crowds are present.Paid shaded parking with shower possible.Possibility to rent a paddle.A seasonal clothing merchant at the entrance to the beachA snack bar, a bar, deckchair rental (50€/day for 2 deckchairs) are on the beaches.

reviews.title: Beach top
reviews.text: Superb beach with clear watersVery largeParking €5 or hut parking possible €20 refund if meal in the restaurant.But parked safely 5 minutes from the beachFine sandSeveral restaurants (Playa Baggia for us very good)Reasonable prices for the spot…

reviews.title: My beach
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach in southern Corsica!The sand, the transparent and turquoise sea, the red rocks and the umbrella pines!Without forgetting to eat a panini at the hut or drink a mojito at sunset

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, beautiful site
reviews.text: Magnificent beach, well-kept parking at 10th per day and at the foot of the beach.Be careful, lots of people on a strip of white sand.

reviews.title: Beautiful but…
reviews.text: Magnificent, even if the wind and jellyfish spoiled the visit a little. Avoid in the middle of the day because traffic jams, parking and space on the beach are a real drag.

reviews.title: Beautiful Porto Vecchio beach
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach and superb sea, certainly, but crowded at the end of July. Not the best time to enjoy...

reviews.title: Entre amis et famille
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach. A little overcrowded but it's worth the detour just for the photos.. the children had a blast with their masks admiring the fish

reviews.title: Just magique !
reviews.text: Simply magnificent, one of the most beautiful beaches in Corsica if not the most beautiful. Paid parking lots €4.50 except the one closest to the beach access which is free but often full.

reviews.title: Spiaggia da vedere
reviews.text: Another beach not to be missed. Crystal clear shallow waters. Strangely free parking which doesn't hurt. Mainly free beach with areas where there are various bars where you can drink and have lunch. I highly recommend le petit pin, a kiosk where you can find food and drinks at strangely honest prices (canned beer €3.50). The owner clearly does not aim to exploit the situation and also speaks Italian. Beach worth seeing

reviews.title: Traum in feinen Dosen
reviews.text: A wonderful piece of nature, parceled out by humans and overpriced at peak times of the season, offered to those hastily searching. Relaxation in wonderful waves and crystal clear water would be great if there weren't balls and hat sellers constantly singing along the beach. Despite it. There was something special about a good meal in one of the beach pavilions on fixed European time (almost German) in the middle of the sand. Traimstrabd, we will not forget you and your fine, soft sand.

reviews.title: Palombaggia .. un classico ma bella !!!
reviews.text: Visited on July 23. One of the best known. Turquoise waters, fine sandy beach. The sea slopes gently (excellent for children). Once you arrive you can park on the street (hourly payment) or go down the slope to the beach. As long as there are spaces, you can go down towards the pine/eucalyptus forest and parking is free. Once the number is reached (usually 10.30-11am) a traffic light comes on and the road is closed by a barrier. As soon as you arrive on the beach, I recommend going to the right, there is a lot of space.  It is a little exposed to winds from both the north and south. In some places lots of algae; choose carefully where to stop.

reviews.title: Plage à voir
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, with toilets (which is rare in Corsica). Ideal for families, easy access. Plenty of parking spaces. You have to walk a good 5 minutes to get from the parking lot to the beach. Straw huts on site.

reviews.title: exceptionnel
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach of fine white sand with turquoise water! Possibility of renting paddles and jetskis Very good restaurant with your feet in the sand

reviews.title: Simplement paradisiaque
reviews.text: Without doubt one of the most beautiful beaches in Southern Corsica. Crystal clear and clean water, fine sand. I recommend the campsite parking for €4 per day, this includes the shower and it is very practical after your swim! And the staff is very nice

reviews.title: Mare strabiliante, spiaggia nella norma
reviews.text: One of the best seas in Corsica, crystal clear and warm. You can also park for free in the pine forest. The free sandy beach, however, is not that exceptional even if it is very long. In fact it is a bit narrow and this increases the overcrowding effect. But in Corsica there are enormous semi-deserted beaches of equal if not greater charm.

reviews.title: Da visitare assolutamente!
