reviews.title: Très belle plage.
reviews.text: A superb beach. We went in July 2023. We were very lucky to find a non-paying place right next to the beach. Not too many people. L'eau est cristalline et le sable blanc. This beach is magnificent and still retains its wild side.

reviews.title: Très belle plage ! Mais beaucoup de monde
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach, warm sun, good weather, clean water. An incredible afternoon typical of the holidays Too bad there were so many people, very little peace and quiet.

reviews.title: Un peu déçu
reviews.text: You can find quieter beaches to the north or south by walking 25 or 40 minutes. It is of course a beautiful beach but a lot of people, little access (in practice you have to use the main car park, free in June, I don't know if it remains free in summer and walk 5 to 10 minutes to the right to leave the very touristy area)

reviews.title: Paradis
reviews.text: Magnificent beach, little paradise, especially at the start of the season. Few people. An ideal corner for the first morning bath

reviews.title: Plage de palombaggia
reviews.text: Magnificent beach which is a real eye-catcher.  Clear, clear water. Great landscape.  I highly recommend.  Free parking

reviews.title: Parking ipini
reviews.text: Great ipini parking!! 50m from the beach, large place in the shade in a magnificent pine forest Open 24/7 2 food trucks on site and also a Paddle rental stand that has never been seen before!!! Top team we highly recommend for a lovely quiet day on the extraordinary Palombaggia beach in Porto-Vecchio

reviews.title: Très belle plage
reviews.text: Very beautiful, large white sand beach with translucent water, some waves depending on the corners. We understand its reputation, but there are obviously a lot of people..

reviews.title: Plaza
reviews.text: A very good beach for younger children. Shallow with lots of waves and beautiful white and fine sand. Plenty of parking space considering that we came on Sunday. Lack of public toilets and cafe bars. There are a few on the beach, but more like restaurants, etc.

reviews.title: Que c'est beau!
reviews.text: in June it's still possible... Later in the season I doubt it! The place is beautiful, but it's already a lot of people in June! We would dream of going there alone :) It’s so beautiful

reviews.title: Victime du tourisme de masse
reviews.text: He oversold and victim of his popularity. Significant presence of algae which is not collected. Personally, I preferred Santa Giulia. The Corsicans should preserve this beach from mass tourism, because it deserves better.

reviews.title: Très belle plage
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach. A great discovery. Shaded but paid parking. Unfortunately a lot of jellyfish.

reviews.title: belle découverte
reviews.text: Very pretty beach with some quiet nooks and crannies. Few people, large parking lot with quick access. Fine sand beach. A real little joy

reviews.title: Ein richtiger Traumstrand!
reviews.text: Simply a real dream beach! We walked from Tamericciu to the end of Palombaggia and were overwhelmed by the impressions.

reviews.title: Blindé et cher en été. Moustiques le soir ...
reviews.text: Armored and dirty in summer. Paid parking lots. All the huts in the area are at stratospheric prices. Go there in June or September. Monster traffic jams in summer.

reviews.title: À refaire
reviews.text: A great stay, a great visit and above all a great experience for a first time in Corsica, a beautiful day on the Lavézie island, and numerous tastings of local charcuterie. I will return soon

reviews.title: Beautiful beach in Corsica
reviews.text: It is a beautiful beach,  one of the best in  Corsica or even in Europe. Only complaint, we went in September and the parking lots were closed, so parking was not easy.

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: Magnificent beach with ample parking, the color of the water is superb, with a transparent blue. It is worth the detour

reviews.title: Petit paradis
reviews.text: Superb beach, plus the weather is magnificent for the month of November. Calm, the water is still fresh so you can swim... what a pleasure....

reviews.title: Un morceau du Paradis
reviews.text: Magnificent and heavenly beach, fine blond sand, crystal clear water. We have been visiting Corsica for several years now but this year gave us a little disappointment when we discovered that the umbrella pine planted on the small islet had been cut down. What a shame they didn't replant another one!

reviews.title: Décevant
reviews.text: Completely degraded by mass tourism, access through the woods, very dirty, rubbish On the beach smell of fried food and generator Too bad the site is wonderful

reviews.title: Émerveillement et souvenir éternel
reviews.text: Discovered alone outside school holidays a few years ago: magical place: of all my trips: one of my most intense emotions: at dusk: I was the only one there!!

reviews.title: Incontournable en Corse du Sud
reviews.text: Few people at the end of September, water at 23° a dream.. the car parks are close to the beach, sheepfold-style toilets available and clean, note that this beach is very large and has several access points.

reviews.title: Magnifique!!!!!
reviews.text: Magnificent beach, crystal clear and warm water. Fine sand and incredible landscape. Renting deckchairs is very expensive!

reviews.title: Super plage
reviews.text: Super beach and very extensive We can see the bottom really well and we can admire the fish that come between our legs or around us This time is great because there are a lot fewer people on the beach and people are very careful not to dirty it We loved spending the day there and having food at the stand where the prices remain very reasonable

reviews.title: Superbe plage
reviews.text: Superb beach in the late afternoon. Be careful, invaded by mosquitoes after 8:00 p.m. But very clean, superb white sand and very pretty landscape with rocks and umbrella pines. Access a little difficult by car

reviews.title: Paradisiaque
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach. Turquoise water, good temperature. We took deckchairs at a price of €20 each. Our parking was free, I recommend

reviews.title: Unser zu Hause
reviews.text: Our favorite beach and at home in La Paillote.Simple and yet beautiful also has other restaurants but we just love Paillote.Attention only cash payment possible

reviews.title: Plage de pallombiaggia
reviews.text: Very pretty beach. We took a deckchair at the hut and it was great. We ate a salad. Unpretentious but correct dish. Very warm welcome.

reviews.title: Una piacevole giornata.
reviews.text: The beach is worth at least one visit. The sea is clear, the clear seabed makes the water transparent. Adapting, it is pleasant to be on the rocks. It is not particularly equipped, so it is better to bring an umbrella.

reviews.title: Bof bof
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach for its turquoise water worthy of a postcard but dirty sand and very busy so towels are a touch. Full parking so you have to park 600m before the beach but go down a lot on the way out so the return is complicated

reviews.title: FANTASTICA !!!
reviews.text: Long as I like it for beautiful walks! Equipped with bar and sunbeds. Water temperature perfect... crystal clear Caribbean!

reviews.title: La mia preferita
reviews.text: I can say that I have visited several and various beaches in southern Corsica and this is certainly the one that struck me the most due to its colours, seabed, sand, relaxation... Wild Corsica gave us a wonderful day in this truly crystalline sea, I have only seen colors like this in Sardinia so far. An unmissable beach but very crowded especially in August, I recommend walking a bit from the car park which takes you to the pine forest and the further you go the more there are fewer people and you will be able to enjoy it to the fullest!

reviews.title: Très belle plage
reviews.text: Splendid beach, little space on the sand but the scenery is worth it! Free parking nearby, others pay at different rates depending on the front or back of the sign...

reviews.title: Plage magnifique
reviews.text: Truly beautiful beach with beautiful clear blue water. In terms of people, the beach is quite large. To avoid people around you, don’t hesitate to walk a little and avoid being near restaurants or parking lots. It's best to come early to get a spot in the free parking lot.

reviews.title: A fuir en haute saison
reviews.text: If you don't want to place your towel 50 cm from the neighbors, go your way and find a small, less frequented cove

reviews.title: Sotto le aspettative
reviews.text: Maybe because we were told it was the best we were disappointed, the pine forest that precedes it is beautiful, transparent water but with algae and a short beach so in August it becomes super crowded and not enjoyable

reviews.title: Bof...
reviews.text: We weren't really lucky and we did this beach on a rather gray day with a little rain. We arrived there around 5 p.m. it was packed with people despite the weather 😯 We stood a little aside on the rocks to put on our fins and snorkels and getting into the water is not easy, the rocks are extremely cutting a lot of sea urchins so you have to be very careful. Nature has all its rights and so much the better I would say but if you want to do this kind of activity with the children to see fish choose another beach 😉 The beach itself is pretty fine sand but I don’t understand the real popularity of it.

reviews.title: Fantastischer Strand
reviews.text: In my opinion, the most beautiful beach in Europe, wonderfully empty in autumn and crystal clear water, uniquely beautiful

reviews.title: La nostra prima spiaggia corsa
reviews.text: Palombaggia was our first lido once we got off the ship in Bastia. This beach is really large, with fine sand and trees around it. Going past the rocks on the left, you arrive at other small coves, where there are also several establishments, with bars and umbrella-sunbed rentals. We parked the motorbike on the main road, which is about a 10-minute walk from the entrance to the lido. The route to get to the beach by vehicle is regulated by a timed traffic light, which manages an alternating one-way system. The asphalt is not the best, furthermore it is not very clear whether entry by vehicle requires a fee or not.

reviews.title: Beautiful soft sandy beach but too busy in August
reviews.text: Beautiful white sandy beach with coffee but very crowed in August. Best to go in late afternoon to enjoy the beauty after people start to leave. Parking can be challenging either free on the side of road (make sure there is no yellow line) or hourly parking.

reviews.title: Meraviglia
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful and long, the color of the sea is turquoise, beautiful! crowded but being large you can stay in peace 😍

reviews.title: Belle plage qui mérite sa réputation…
reviews.text: Great beach, very beautiful with lots of fish and transparent water…Unfortunately a little too busy in August.

reviews.title: Spiaggia fantastica
reviews.text: Fabulous place, if you are in the area you can't miss coming, crystal clear waters, lots of fish to fish but snorkelling is a pleasure and the white beach gives you a sense of the Caribbean

reviews.title: Plage quelconque
reviews.text: Currently on vacation in Santa Giulia, I don't understand the craze and ecstasy for Palombaggia beach... dirty and crowded beach

reviews.title: Palombaggia “sud”
reviews.text: We entered from the southernmost entrance, the one towards Tamaricciu, parking the car near Botti Racing for €10 a day, right next to the beach. Unfortunately here the water was a bit dirty and full of boats, jet skis and dinghies, not far from the shore, resulting in the smell of diesel. After lunch we moved to Tamaricciu via the path (5 min walk)

reviews.title: Excellent !
reviews.text: Large, magnificent beach, turquoise and clean water, fine and clean sand, go there in the morning to enjoy the calm, no smell of algae like in some annex beaches

reviews.title: Très jolie plage en soit, mais..
reviews.text: Very pretty beach in itself, if we omit the cigarette butts in the sand or the waste left by certain vacationers. The seabed is splendid, unfortunately it is not enough to compensate for the rest. Crowded in high season: you can't go 1m without a towel at 10am. Beyond all that, wasps, you name it, impossible to eat for 20 seconds without being attacked. A big disappointment, Santa Giulia is still more pleasant

reviews.title: Belle plage, mais…
reviews.text: Just look under the umbrellas if you see children and you will understand that they do not rent umbrellas with children. It’s sad such a beautiful beach which chooses tourists, rich and children 🥹

reviews.title: Belle mais...
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach but crowded! Victim of his reputation and the lack of respect from people. In 2022, still finding cigarette butts in the sand is astonishing! Infested with wasps this year. Impossible to picnic there. But to see the sunset it's worth it!

reviews.title: Super plage
reviews.text: Super beach, very wild, very little maintained but very beautiful, bring a parasol with the family. Parking starts at 20 euros, the one at the back is the cheapest, 10 euros for the same service.

reviews.title: La plus belle plage
reviews.text: Magnificent beach, turquoise water, a little crowded in July but still OK. A thousand times better than Santa Giulia

reviews.title: Belle plage, comme beaucoup d’autres.
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach. Go there early because already at 10 a.m. there are a few people (more than on the multitudes of other beaches in the region) It's beautiful but quite honestly, other beaches in the area are just as beautiful. So go ahead because the bottoms are pretty and the fish are present even at the edge but you will enjoy just as much going towards pianottoli where you will find the water just as beautiful and the beach less (much less) crowded

reviews.title: Petite plage sympa
reviews.text: Small, nice beach with transparent and warm water. Don't forget a parasol because there's no place to get shade.

reviews.title: très bonne expérience
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach, the water is very translucent. There weren't many people in July... and the parking lot was open until late in the morning. Of course, it is the most famous beach in Southern Corsica... and we understand why...

reviews.title: Plage avec ambiance les uns sur les autres.
reviews.text: Indeed, it is one of the most beautiful beaches in Corsica. Turquoise water, Dominican island atmosphere, fine sand, sandbank for 40 m but because there is a but! Too many people... without embarrassment... without respect for others... on top of each other. Forget the zen attitude moments. For mask and snorkel lovers you will be disappointed... it has almost no fish. Logically, they no longer have room to swim because there are too many people in the water.

reviews.title: Paradisiaque
reviews.text: Discovery of this legendary beach on July 20. There were certainly people there but not as many as on the French Riviera. Water transparent and really warm. For access, we passed the paid car parks to arrive at a large dirt car park (well passable) which is free and gives access less than 100 meters to the northern part of the beach. Arrived around 5 p.m., no problem finding space either in the parking lot or on the beach. Happiness!

reviews.title: La plus belle plage !!
reviews.text: I went to this beach in July 2022, and for me it will remain the most beautiful of all those I have visited. A good time shared with my friends and a very clean beach. Bars and restaurants are still expensive.

reviews.title: Kallisté
reviews.text: Very beautiful water, sumptuous atmosphere, a dream beach for the Mediterranean! The island of beauty, Kallisté, that is to say Corsica, here offers itself as much as a Caribbean beach!

reviews.title: Spiaggia Carina
reviews.text: It's clear that after seeing Rondinara, I have to give this beach 4 dots. The judgment must be contextualized. If we were in Sardinia this beach wouldn't even be in the top 100. However, a nice beach, paid parking of your choice, either 20 euros or 10 euros for an extra 10 meters of driving.

reviews.title: A ne pas manquer
reviews.text: For us the most beautiful beach in Corsica. If you arrive from Porto Vecchio, there are plenty of parking lots down near the beach (some more than others, don't necessarily stop at the first), for 6€/day. If you arrive from Santa Giulia, very complicated parking, the best is to go to the private beach parking lot (Palm beach or Playa Baggia) charged €20 but deductible if you eat in these huts. Little tip if you like to dive, at Cape Tamaricciu, there is a pretty rock that is quite safe for jumping from 4 to 6m. It faces the sea, hard to see from the edge.

reviews.title: Beautiful !!!!
reviews.text: A really beautiful beach, you have to like the crowds but apart from that, it's worth the detour!!! One of my favorite beaches

reviews.title: Commerciale ma comunque bellissima
reviews.text: Scared at the idea of ​​having to spend 20-30 euros on parking, we looked for a place along the road, away from the beach. The daily ticket cost us 10 euros, but going down towards the beach we saw that - for example - the parking at Botti racing cost 10 euros for the whole day and it was right next to the beach! at 11 it was still empty so I imagine you could find a seat at any time. reviews.title: Comment dire ? Ah oui : mort de rire !
reviews.text: Lonely Planet Corsica rightly indicates that this beach is so praised that “some are (almost) disappointed when they see it” (p. 243). I'm one of those people who doesn't find anything special about this place. Water, sand, sun. Yes, it is a beach. A beach whose sand is filled with everything and nothing. However, when we see the prices charged by certain providers, we should perhaps offer a beach worthy of the name. To start with the “parking”. Once you arrive at the end, you will learn that you have to turn around between the two rows of sometimes anarchically parked cars. Rough road, narrow lanes, the perfect equation for hanging your vehicle. There is no infrastructure even though the places are very busy. The beach itself is not great. The sand is filled with marine debris, it is separated from private land by barbed wire and, in some cases, rickety wooden stakes. And even though it's a non-smoking beach, cigarette butts are everywhere. If you want to reserve a deckchair, hold on tight. I live on the Côte d'Azur, yet I have never seen that: 50 euros a day with the obligation to eat in the restaurant!... I laughed when the young girl told me the price. As for the attractions, the cost is the same: 45 euros to rent a paddle for half a day. Basically, you already have to count on 50 euros for a deckchair, plus around fifteen euros for consumption and 45 euros for paddle if you want to do it, so more than a hundred euros. The only interest remains the donkeys and goats which wander behind the fences and which approach to ask for caresses. Frankly, we went to Ghjunchitu beach on the Ile Rousse side, and it is much better organized, prettier and pleasant. Furthermore, people told us they preferred Santa Giulia or Rondinara beach. I can understand. Don't let Palombaggia's overused reputation fool you.

Like every beach in Corsica, it is beautiful, there is no doubt about it, but the most spectacular thing about this beach is the sea, blue, crystalline, clean, inhabited. The sea is inhabited by a lot of fish, it is very nice to snorkel, or simply dive to understand that you are swimming among hundreds of fish. For those who talk about algae, calm down, algae are not waste (on every beach in southern Corsica there are signs that specify this everywhere), but rather algae are plants that create food and nourishment for fish, and act as "cement" to hold the sand together during the winter and make the beach resist storm surges.
