reviews.text: The site is splendid. His reputation is justified. On the other hand, the omnipresent music and the noise of the water scooters tarnish the picture a little. It's a shame

reviews.title: 10-20-30€ le parking
reviews.text: The closer you get to the beach, the more expensive the parking. We are Corsican and we find this unacceptable. The beach is a common good for everyone. 30€ parking please… followed by a comment “for as long as you want” We turned around and went back to the hotel swimming pool.

reviews.title: Plage à découvrir obligatoirement
reviews.text: Paradise beach first impression from our friend It feels like the Marquesas!! why go so far when we have this magnificent beach….. visit in June with few people therefore ideal

reviews.title: Très belle plage
reviews.text: Superb beach lined with umbrella pines. Turquoise water and red rocks. At the beginning of July there were still few people on the beach but it was already difficult to find a place along the road. One of my favorites with its neighbor Tamariceu

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: Superb beach. Few people out of season. Lots of people in high season but worth the detour I recommend The Playa Baggia restaurant on this beach

reviews.title: Amazing place 🏝
reviews.text: What to say? It’s magnificent! 😍This beach is huge and so beautiful. The water is turquoise. These red rocks are magnificent. Very nice photo spot Ideal period for us because few people, thank you June Warning: when arriving at the parking lot, for low cars it is complicated!

reviews.title: Époustouflant
reviews.text: How lucky to have been able to go there at the very beginning of July before the massive arrival of tourists in mid-July/August, sublime water, not many people, so really the feeling of being almost alone! Come early in the morning to have a shaded parking space close to the beach and of course with parasols

reviews.title: Plage magnifique
reviews.text: Magical place Superb beach of fine, almost white sandCrystal clear waterSeveral straw huts Accessible

reviews.title: Tres beau
reviews.text: White sand, fine sand, turquoise blue water, several services Supervised beach for children is good

reviews.title: Plage magnifique
reviews.text: Beach difficult to access because no sign indicates it, otherwise find someone with a towel around their neck who shows you the path to follow, Corsica belongs to the Corsicans, it shows

reviews.title: A ne pas rater
reviews.text: The panorama is just exceptional! Above all, don't miss it. The Da Mare restaurant is a very good address (restaurant + beach)

reviews.title: Non mi ha particolarmente impressionato...
reviews.text: It was the first beach I visited during my holiday in Corsican land and I must say that, perhaps due to the weather not being the best, I wasn't too impressed. The surrounding beaches certainly deserve more.

reviews.title: petit, sauvage, beau, depaysant
reviews.text: very beautiful place that makes for a dream, fine sand, very clear water, small beach, so not too many people, great bars. A dream setting

reviews.title: Pas la plus belle
reviews.text: Nice beach but it is not the most beautiful in Corsica especially with all the algae in the water and on the sand. In addition, in the event of strong wind, everything flies and it is unpleasant. Plus it's not very deep. Easy to park. Certainly the road is narrow as some people complain but that is why there is a traffic light...

reviews.title: Que dire
reviews.text: What can we say about this beach other than that it is a pure jewel of nature. A color of water that reminds me of the Bahamas, fine warm sand, the wind, in short, a dream. Too bad that one day out of the 2 we were there the beach was closed because of oil pellets found following the degassing of a tanker

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: Superb spot, between sea and mountains... Truly magnificent setting despite the crowds present in the summer period. My favorite beach in Corsica.

reviews.title: Magnifique !
reviews.text: Gorgeous ! Corsican beaches have nothing to envy of Caribbean beaches! Fine white sand, clear water, bright environment…. It's all there!

reviews.title: Mooi, druk en duur
reviews.text: I found the beach quite boring. Plus you have to pay everywhere to get there. It is a beautiful bay, but busy. So I would look for something else in the area.

reviews.title: Très jolie plage, assez exiguë et exploitée de façon abusive
reviews.text: We went to spend a day on this beach, which has the reputation of being one of the most beautiful in Corsica. The sand on the beach is very fine and the color of the water is reminiscent of the lagoons of the Pacific. The beach, like all those washed by the Mediterranean, is very narrow due to low tides and is therefore quickly invaded by tourists. The deckchair rental provides pleasant comfort, but is offered at a prohibitive price (25 euros per person!). In conclusion, I would say that the beauty of the beach is indisputable, but that its commercial exploitation is questionable.

reviews.title: Sublimes nuances de Bleu
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in Corsica and that’s what you feel when you arrive there. Despite a narrow path and parking spaces that are difficult to find, once parked, a few minutes' walk and you will be able to distinguish all the shades of blue that the sea has to offer us. Uncrowded beach in June, and that is much appreciated. But, we regret the absence of a beach bar (closed at 5 p.m.) to cool off and the presence of ants! Suitable for family, couples, friends, children, because the sea is shallow for a good length. For the more motivated, you will be able to see some fish if you put on snorkel masks.

reviews.title: Belle plage
reviews.text: Superb beach, the color of the water is magnificent... Beach without too many people for the month of June. The only negative point is that there are a lot of ants there...

reviews.title: Une des plus belles plages
reviews.text: Superb beach despite the crowds. Perfect for children since the sea is shallow for a while.

reviews.title: Toujours aussi magnifique
reviews.text: The beach is still superb, especially at the beginning of June without the summer crowds. I was happy not to see the bars encroaching all the way to the sea, which usually forces families and passers-by to slalom between drunken pseudo jetsetters.

reviews.title: Le paradis existe !
reviews.text: Narrow road access before reaching the beach. Free but difficult parking. Crossing vehicles sometimes difficult. But all this for…a MAGNIFICENT beach! Go there with your eyes closed 😁🏝

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: Superb beach with turquoise waters and a beach of fine white sand. Unmissable in Corsica Worth the detour

reviews.title: Une pure merveille mais certainement différent l'été
reviews.text: It has been described in the magazines as one of the most beautiful beaches in Corsica and I completely agree the sand is fine the water is translucent and it is paradise but in May it is certainly much more pleasant than the summer when the crowds must be numerous and I probably wouldn't like that here you can walk on the sand along the beach stroll with your feet in the water without having to bump into anyone I even went for a swim Of course the water was very cool but the view was too beautiful. Restaurants with parking are around this beach. I imagine that in the summer, parking there is mission impossible....

reviews.title: Splendide
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful Corsican beaches. I have only visited the south of Corsica and it is my favorite. Magnificent beach, transparent water and mountain view, magnificent!!!

reviews.title: Grande plage, mais pas si belle que cela...
reviews.text: We read everywhere that Palombaggia is one of the most beautiful beaches on the island, the reputation is overestimated.  The beach is certainly large but not so beautiful, especially compared to others less known like that of Saint-Cyprien which has finer sand and a prettier landscape, and superb water.

reviews.title: Superbe plage
reviews.text: very pretty beach with its white sand and fine, very clear water with a very beautiful turquoise blue color.

reviews.title: Superbe plage
reviews.text: SUPERB BEACH Total change of scenery and very easy to park, I recommend it to all beach lovers!!!

reviews.title: Magnifique plage !!
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach. Best done early or out of season to fully enjoy its beauty! Several parking lots near the beach.

reviews.title: Déçu
reviews.text: This much-vaunted beach did not have the desired effect, others are in my opinion more beautiful, nevertheless it remains a beautiful beach.

reviews.title: Praia Paradisíaca
reviews.text: Perfect example of a paradisiacal beach. A white sand beach, crystal clear turquoise water with a warm temperature. Ideal for relaxing and contemplating.

reviews.title: Sûrement une des plus belle plage...
reviews.text: ...from Corsica for sure, but which would be so much more beautiful without the hustle and bustle of August... Just like its little sister Santa Giulia, turquoise water and fine sand, with the mountains in the background. Except that in the foreground it is Disney land Paris

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: We came to Corsica in September 2020. Palombaggia beach was highly recommended to us and we understand why! This beach is a real postcard beach. The beach is very large, with part sand and part rock. The sand is white and very fine (like flour), and the rocks are really special (like those in the Seychelles). The water is transparent and we can even see very small fish. The setting is idyllic with many restaurants on the sandy part. Ideal for cooling off or for lunch. We are lucky, we were able to swim in water at 26°C in September. Access is not very well indicated, you have to park on the winding roads and walk down to the beach. We will definitely come back to take a bath for our next vacation in Corsica.

reviews.title: sublime
reviews.text: This beach is sublime, especially when there are not many people. The only problem is parking

reviews.title: Plage magnifique surtout hors saison
reviews.text: One of my favorite beaches. It’s a shame that the emblem of this beach, the beautiful umbrella pine, was cut above the wall. But it remains no less magnificent 🌴

reviews.title: Paris les plus belles plages de l'Est
reviews.text: Little frequented at that time. You can enjoy the beauty of this heavenly beach. The water is beautiful

reviews.title: plage sympas
reviews.text: This beach was beautiful but a little disappointing, nothing special, I saw much more beautiful flats but no one talked about it. But it still remains a very beautiful beach!!

reviews.title: Jolie plage
reviews.text: Very large beach with fine sand and turquoise water. Pleasant at this time because not many people. Afterwards we were a little disappointed with the praise we had read before coming. For snorkel enthusiasts there is nothing to see underwater unfortunately. Big waves in windy weather.

reviews.title: Beaucoup de poissons !!
reviews.text: Magnificent for snorkeling. The water is clear and the many rocks allow you to see lots of fish. Parking is paid and the beach is very crowded, even out of season. Some beach restaurants that we did not try.

reviews.title: Très belle baie
reviews.text: Great walk on this beach and along the path in the October sun. A pure joy to have a drink or nibble something in front of this crystal clear water

reviews.title: J'y retournerai
reviews.text: Superb beach with deckchair and parasol, little corner of paradise, idyllic setting and not too many people. Restaurant on the beach, very generous servings.

reviews.title: Une déception
reviews.text: We think this beach is a victim of its advertising. There is nothing spectacular about the beauty of the site, many other Corsican beaches are more beautiful

reviews.title: Plage magnifique
reviews.text: Superb beach with its huts by the sea. It feels good to rest in the sun in an idyllic setting 😎😃✌️

reviews.title: Vacances magnifiques
reviews.text: Little corner of paradise ❤️Easy to access, not to be missed Restaurant on the beach a little expensive compared to the service, pity board 25 euros ham and cheese in bulk

reviews.title: Moment farniente
reviews.text: Beautiful colors and hot water. A delight for the beginning of October. Low attendance. A real plus!!!

reviews.title: Très belle plage. Mais accès difficile.
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach. Crystal clear water. Fine sand. Few people in September. But getting there is a feat. A very small road. Cars park on the side of the road for hundreds of meters (kilometers?). Crossings prove impossible. Let's not talk about turning around to leave...No parking...

reviews.title: belle étendue, bien exposée
reviews.text: Restaurants and bars on the beach, but without crowding, so very pleasant. Long sandy beach and clear water.

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: Magnificent view. Small, pleasant, clean beach with ample parking. Total change of scenery. To get there the right is winding but it's worth it

reviews.title: une plage comme à Bora Bora!
reviews.text: A postcard and magnificent landscape, access is not easy but there is parking at the beach restaurants

reviews.title: Merveilleuse plage aux eaux cristallines
reviews.text: A beach worthy of the most beautiful beaches in the Caribbean. To be consumed without moderation in September when most of the tourists have disappeared.

reviews.title: Cadre idyllique
reviews.text: The site is splendid, you think you are on the other side of the world. The sea is azure blue. In summer the site must be a little crowded but in September the best

reviews.title: Magnifique plage
reviews.text: Visit on September 28. A bit of a hassle to park but once you arrive at the beach, what splendor! One of the most beautiful beaches on the coast. Turquoise, transparent water, small snack bar at the entrance,...

reviews.title: Les SECHELLES à 1 heures de Paris
reviews.text: Why go looking for thousands of KMS when FRANCE offers us such beauty. Not counting Santa Guilia, Rondinara, Pinarellu and all the others, each more beautiful than the other

reviews.title: Plage très prisée
reviews.text: Splendid location. Several possible accesses. Slightly chaotic parking... Not suitable for people with reduced mobility.

reviews.title: Toujours aussi magnifique !
reviews.text: It's all in the title...! One of the most beautiful beaches in Corsica. Some restaurants (not cheap) offer to eat with your feet in the water!

reviews.title: Belle plage
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, white sand but quite a few people. You have to see it when you are in the region. Difficult to park;

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: Idyllic setting, Magnificent beach! The water is crystal clear, we were able to do a little snorkeling near the rocks but not much to see, a few schools of fish but not extraordinary. Clean beach ideal for children because it is very far away.

reviews.title: Impraticable
reviews.text: Winding and narrow road crossing impossible to reach a narrow and uninteresting beachDisappointed and more beautiful beaches not far away

reviews.title: Inoubliable Palombaggia
reviews.text: Paradise beach. The water is clear, the sand is clean. Exceptional view of the mountains that surround the bay.

reviews.title: La plus belle des plage corse
reviews.text: Turquoise and transparent water, white sand. A fantastic landscape. Possibility of eating on site.

reviews.title: Une des plus belles plage de Corse
reviews.text: A sublime place where we must stop for its idyllic setting, its turquoise waters and its fine sand

reviews.title: Superbe !
reviews.text: A huge turquoise swimming pool. Equipped beach, nice restaurants. An exceptional view from the deckchairs at Petit Chose! Special mention to Camille and her warm welcome.

reviews.title: Belle plage, mais beaucoup trop touristique
reviews.text: Beautiful beach...certainly but which does not at all correspond to the idea we had of Corsica with confidential coves, but that again depends on everyone's tastes. Moreover, during this Covid 19 period, people do not respect distancing, we find ourselves on top of each other and when we dare to ask these people for a little distance without embarrassment, they laugh in our faces...we prefer to leave!

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: Superb beach, turquoise water! On the other hand: if you don't want to damage your car, my advice is either to park along the road or type in kalliste diving to find real parking lots (3.50e per day and 5 minutes walk). On the paying side you will come across the best place for snorkeling because on the other side there are no rocks and therefore very few fish.

reviews.title: bof bof y a mieux et gratuit
reviews.text: frankly very disappointed by this beach renowned for being the most beautiful on the island I have seen better: silver beach Marinella beach St Cyprien beach etc. if you do not want to pay 10 euros for parking leave your car on the side of the road at your own risk!! there are plenty of small beaches in Corsica much quieter in my opinion it is a tourist trap

reviews.title: Plage
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach with clear blue sand and water. Restaurants and bars on the beach. Free and paid parking nearby.

reviews.title: LA PLUS PLAGE POUR MOI
reviews.text: 10 years without Corsica is a lot... too much. I found this beach and introduced it to my wife who fell in love with it.

reviews.title: Une des plus belle plage
reviews.text: We love the beaches of Corsica, particularly those in the South. We particularly recommend this beach for families.

reviews.title: Plage de Palombaggia
reviews.text: Very disappointed by this beach, I was expecting to see the beach that we see in all the photos (with rocks and umbrella pines) but it is only a very long strip of sand, white and fine certainly but like many others in Corsica, the pines and rocks are undoubtedly in the cove which follows the beach, at the very end. I really don't see why there is such a hype about this beach, many others are just as pretty. Very difficult access, small rutted road, to pass another car you have to stop, turn in the mirrors, walk forward with your head out the door, praying that it passes!! I saw it once, I won't go back.

reviews.title: Déçu
reviews.text: We had seen so many magnificent photos of this beach that we had to go see it! What a disappointment! Very narrow beach, interspersed with rocks that you have to climb if you want to go further With huts that take up a lot of space on the beach Not very clean that day Lots of algae on the sand and in the water Honestly, we won't go back there again, that's for sure Santa Giulia beach, a little further away, is for my part prettier and wider Not even photos to put because they don't do anything good!

reviews.title: Sublime
reviews.text: Heavenly beach with little fish that come to bite you haha ​​little hut with a very nice boss

reviews.title: la plus belle pour nous
reviews.text: very beautiful beach you have to walk a little complicated to park but superb with a very gradual descent into the water

reviews.title: Très belle plage comme toutes celles de Corse !
reviews.text: A little disappointed. Perhaps I had made too much of a film about this beach which is certainly magnificent but which, victim of its success, is mostly full of people and it is mid-September and during the week. The parking lot further distorts its charm. We went to another beach that was just as beautiful and with a lot fewer people. You just need to search a little. After all, we are on vacation. We had time.

reviews.title: Plage de Palombagia
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but VERY DIFFICULT to access. Not enough access and no signage from the road.

reviews.title: Bonne plage
reviews.text: Unlike others we did not pay for parking. Beautiful beach like almost all the others. Clear water we see a lot of fish. Fairly calm water and sheltered from the wind

reviews.title: A voir une fois pas plus
reviews.text: Pretty beach, nothing more, very "have you seen me": you can find equally beautiful ones a few kilometers further. Exorbitant parking price: €20 per day!! Staying in the neighborhood: no basic necessities store (bakery for example), no shop (impossible to buy a postcard there...), difficult walks because of unsafe roads... Seen it once, won't go back. I have been staying in Corsica every summer for 10 years and there is so much better, more intimate, more equipped, more financially affordable, more accessible to "everyone"

reviews.title: Superbe plage
reviews.text: Magnificent beach, very clean which lives up to its reputation Superb moments spent with family

reviews.title: Paradisiaque
reviews.text: Superb beach... magnificent... has nothing to envy of the Caribbean beaches... don't miss the Palm Beach hut! Great welcome... deckchair and good cocktail!

reviews.title: Très jolie et agréable plage
reviews.text: Very pretty beach with white sand. Clear and warm water for September. You can find huts there. Please note: no parking, you must park along the road. If you park near the beach, you will have problems leaving because two cars have great difficulty passing each other.

reviews.title: COVID-19? Connaît pas.
reviews.text: Exhorbitantly priced huts for canteen snacks. And what can you say when you see the guy behind the counter using his hands to fill the bowls of fries that he serves to the customer?

reviews.title: La plus belle plage du sud de la corse !
reviews.text: Superb beach both for its beauty and the transparency of the water! You won't regret it's paradise!

reviews.title: La plus belle plage de Corse!
reviews.text: it was just magnificent. Right next to Porto-Vecchio. We loved it. The beach, the fine sand, the crystal clear water, everything was just magnificent. Parking not far away.

reviews.title: Très jolie
reviews.text: A very pretty beach. There weren't many people so no problem putting down our towel.

reviews.title: Très belle plage mais touristique
reviews.text: Sublime beach but crowded with tourists. However, it is worth the detour! Remember to park upstream as there is no parking

reviews.title: Eau cristalline
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach with crystal clear water, possibility of parking along the road going down and presence of a bar. Very good time spent

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: Beach visited late in the afternoon. Great shaded car. Turquoise water, transparent and warm, fine sand. We parked on the side of the road (10 minutes walk), it's worth it because otherwise parking in restaurants for €20 (deductible from the meal if you eat there). There were few people on this late September afternoon ☀️

reviews.title: Sublime
reviews.text: Superb beach, turquoise water... It's paradise. It's an unmissable beach, a must-see! Advice: Avoid July and August because of the overcrowding and arrive early in the morning if you want to park close to the sea and free.

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: Superb beach, to be recommended. In addition, there are large car parks as well as 2 areas for motorhomes day and night! Park4Night

reviews.title: La plus belle plage
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have seen among my various trips Crystal clear water, be careful the sun is very strong A must-see in the region

reviews.title: Parking payant
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach but we can regret the parking which has become paying (3.5€). Motorhomes can park overnight for €10.

reviews.title: Belle plage mais acces en voiture horrible
reviews.text: We went to this beach in mid-September by car. We went down to the bottom of the alley (see the GPS) and once we reached the end, we were blocked by a barrier except that access is two-way and cars are parked on either side.  I might as well tell you: it's a hassle to turn around and park. The ideal is to park at the top and walk to the beach.

reviews.title: Un cadre magnifique
reviews.text: This beach is worth it with its parking lots 500 meters from the water but what a panoramic view once you arrive. A white sand beach, turquoise water, the mountains and pine forests in the background, everything you need to have a great day.

reviews.title: Des sardines sur la plage!!
reviews.text: If you are looking for a quiet place, don't go to Palombaggia beach. All the tourists are on this beach.

reviews.title: Fabuleux
reviews.text: In full sun for sunbathing or better, At sunset, enjoy the calm and the landscape over a drink on the sand...

reviews.title: Magnifique, incontournable
reviews.text: Probably the most beautiful beach in Corsica! Fine sand, turquoise water... who would think we are in France! Ideal with young children because there is little depth along the beach. The beach is huge, you will definitely find the ideal place to put your towel. Several beach restaurants allow you to eat lunch or dinner, have an aperitif or even breakfast.

reviews.title: Magnifique plage
reviews.text: Large white sand beach with crystal clear waters..retaurant playa baggia opens on this beach, it has parking and the menu is exquisite

reviews.title: Belle plage
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach which retains its authenticity, even with a lot of people. Easy access by parking lots in the pine forest. Very clear water, the only downside is a lot of dry algae on the beach.... Afterwards it's a little paradise.

reviews.title: A éviter
reviews.text: Disastrous welcome, we left very quickly (with a “get out” from the waitress)!! Avoid.

reviews.title: Très jolie plage
reviews.text: Very pretty, busy beach even in September. Beach with fine sand and turquoise water. Easy access despite lack of parking space

reviews.title: Bellissima
reviews.text: Wonderful sea. Beach also, almost totally free. Beautiful, one of our favorite beaches.

reviews.title: Plage incontournable.
reviews.text: You have to earn this beach because access without paid parking is practically impossible. Do not hesitate to explore the coast which offers a diversity of sites, large white sand beach, either rocky cove for lovers of magnificent seabeds, or small, very narrow steep beach surrounded by rocks reminiscent of dolmens.

reviews.title: Une plage de rêve
reviews.text: Easy access and above all a very large free shaded car park just a stone's throw from the beach. Be careful, there are a few paid parking lots before you arrive at the beach. Don't fall into the trap! Otherwise, a beach with clear, turquoise waters. Fine sand and a breathtaking view. Take a walk on this beach to the famous gray rocks which resemble the Seychelles and behind discover Tamaricciu beach! An enchantment! We don't expect to see this. It's like Virgin Gorda in the Caribbean in the British Virgin Islands! Go for it! Run there!

reviews.title: Belle plage mais trop de monde
reviews.text: Nice beach but too many people.  The water is translucent, watch out for algae. Good swimming. Large parking lot and possibility to eat on site.

reviews.title: Une plage magnifique
reviews.text: The transparent, warm, turquoise water is just pure happiness. Possibility of parking or along the road.

reviews.title: Der Schönste auf Korsika
reviews.text: This is really the most beautiful beach in Corsica and therefore there is a lot going on. But you can find your spot. It's very clean and the water is crystal clear. But we found 20€ to park too much, so we parked at the top of the street and walked the 5 minutes. We also think 58€ for two loungers plus an umbrella is grossly overpriced. But as long as the tourists pay, why not? The next day we were at Sant Giulia. It was flooded with tons of seaweed. This one is really a dream.

reviews.title: Nessun servizio
reviews.text: A paradise beach, crystal clear sea and very fine sand. The only flaw is that there are no showers or toilets. We asked the restaurant if we could wash the baby in the shower, obviously paying, but nothing. We couldn't use the restaurant shower because we didn't have lunch there. Too bad just for this but the beach is wonderful. Positive that it is a non-smoking beach.

reviews.title: Victime de la surfréquentation
reviews.text: A very disappointing experience returning to this beach where I have childhood memories (and photographs which attest to the difference). In addition to the impression that the beach has shrunk (subjective or reality due to coastal erosion?), it suffers from overcrowding, huts and various developments which have taken away the wild and heavenly aspect which gave it its charm. You probably have to come out of season.

reviews.title: Plage magnifique
reviews.text: Magnificent beach with crystal clear water. I recommend arriving via the Tamaricciu path rather than via the car park which reveals a more charming side of the beach, always take a left on the path.

reviews.title: Paradisiaque !
reviews.text: Paradise beach! When I went there it was very hot! There was a lot of very hot wind, and therefore waves! It was great!

reviews.title: Eau magnifique
reviews.text: The water is clear and a magnificent turquoise. The beach has white sand. However, all this magical landscape described by the postcards is spoiled by the very significant presence of Posidonia present both in the water and on the beach. Well aware that this is a protected species and necessary for the survival of the beaches, they invade the space and make the beach and swimming much less pleasant. Listening to the people around us, I heard the same feeling. Is there not a way to "clean" the beach even if it is an algae or plant to be exact...We discovered this beach at the beginning of September and were able to park without difficulty in the free parking lot. However the beach is not very big and there are a lot of people, I don't dare imagine in peak season... The beach is also very encroached with private payotte beaches for a coastline that wants to be "wild", it's a shame.....

reviews.title: Plage agréable
reviews.text: To discover, you have to walk a little to find a quiet space. Clear water, view of the bay

reviews.title: Vacances en Corse
reviews.text: Corsican paradise beach, crystal clear water and white sand create this postcard setting with these large granite rocks. Magnificent. An unforgettable memory.

reviews.title: Bellissima
reviews.text: It was one of our favorite beaches! Truly beautiful! Crystal clear water and clean white sand!

reviews.title: Belle plage avec beau sable fin
reviews.text: Very beautiful long sandy beach. The only downside is not enough space and room to place your towel, the sea rises very high. Within a few years the beach should disappear. Reserve your deckchair in advance because it fills up quickly.

reviews.title: Plage grande et belle
reviews.text: Superb landscape in clear water. Easy access and not crowded beach. Perfect for children with a long strip of sand with little depth

reviews.title: Sable blanc mais Noir de monde
reviews.text: I had been praised so much about these beaches of Palombaggia...we were disappointed...Inaccessible in August very long and bumpy road to get there crowded parking lot In short, it is better to choose smaller and less famous beaches that are just as pretty, the names of which I will not mention so as not to find the crowds there next year...

reviews.title: plage de palombaggia
reviews.text: Hello, beautiful beach, but for the prettiest side you have to go to the end where there is a little nature left. I STRONGLY advise against this beach in July and August, really too busy unless you like the sardine effect.

reviews.title: Paradisiaque
reviews.text: A heavenly beach, umbrella pines, transparent turquoise blue water and luckily not many people

reviews.title: Belle plage mais pas la best
reviews.text: It's a beautiful beach with pretty colors but lots of pieces of plastic in the water. Too bad for the many fish present in the water. We found free parking under the pines, the path is chaotic but it's ok. For us it's not the most beautiful but on the podium nonetheless. The most worrying being water pollution 😭

reviews.title: La vérité sur Palombaggia
reviews.text: Palombaggia is no longer what it was. In the middle of summer, it has become a primarily commercial beach, with parking for... 20 euros please!!! (2020 influence?) You will find a restaurant, a private beach and dozens, even hundreds of sun loungers spread out everywhere. Masses of people gathered together who believe they are seeing the best of Corsica when they are being made to pay a high price for a distorted site. All with background music and waiters running around. If you want to find more calm, cleanliness and authenticity, go further south. The emblematic beach that we show you on postcards with an umbrella pine (which unfortunately no longer exists) is in fact that of Tamaricciu. Make no mistake.

reviews.title: Formidable
reviews.text: The best of the best. Always so beautiful, transparent waters, umbrella pines, a postcard in its purest form. It doesn't change from year to year. We always put ourselves in the middle, and we escape the deckchairs in the straw huts. Dream beach.

reviews.title: Très beau mais..
reviews.text: Undoubtedly a magnificent beach and perfectly suited to families... Lots of people, it's true. A must see but there are better if you look carefully!!

reviews.title: Una delle più belle se non...
reviews.text: Few words, you have to see it live. Unique water color and great beach for everyone. Correct spacing and a pine forest to cover

reviews.title: Top
reviews.text: Too beautiful!! You really have to go there and a little detour to Sea Lounge, a superb place on Palombaggia! The place is magnificent!

reviews.title: MARE E CAOS
reviews.text: It's August, so the beach casino rule applies, but it was just too much. The sea is beautiful, as is the case throughout southern Corsica, but an obligatory stop for one of the beaches with the best sea.

reviews.title: Tante spiagge magnifiche
reviews.text: When talking about the beaches of the Porto Vecchio - Palombaggia coast, we must distinguish carefully given their number. In fact, there are many bays and even more access points to the sea, almost all with free parking on the street. The common denominator is the transparency of the seabed and the colors of the sea. The tip of Acciaghju and especially the opposite end of Tamaricciu are worth visiting, with the island of rocks with a deep seabed suitable for snorkelling.

reviews.title: Survendue !!!
reviews.text: A nice beach but a little oversold. So a lot of people. People who are extremely incapable of parking their vehicles even endanger traffic and the safety of motorists, while a little further away the parking lots costing €3.50 per day are empty. In short, there are many other beaches in this corner of Corsica that are much quieter and just as pretty, or even prettier.

reviews.title: Corse 2020
reviews.text: Beautiful beach! Beautifully clean and warm sea. Of course, a little more people in the season. Excellent restaurants. Quite busy during the day (music, boats)

reviews.title: Effectivement plage magnifique
reviews.text: I agree with the general opinion on this very beautiful beach. Translucent waters, clean but with a lot of people. It is better to go there very early...

reviews.title: Déçue ...
reviews.text: I am very disappointed by this beach, certainly the setting is heavenly like all the beaches in Corsica but this one is very narrow it is difficult to put your towel down in August without being on top of each other. To park, do not take the paid parking lots, you have to continue and you will find a fairly large free parking lot. I think that to appreciate the place you have to favor the morning or the evening.

reviews.title: Plage sublime
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in Corsica!! A truly magnificent place that we discovered this summer

reviews.title: Magnifique plage
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach in southern Corsica Turquoise water and very long beach Attention very quickly filled ++++

reviews.title: Male
reviews.text: Long but not so big beach, with some refreshment points but one in the middle not recommended! Very very crowded beach, I expected more!

reviews.title: Le paradis sur terre
reviews.text: Turquoise water, fine sand, and dream decor. The pleasure of swimming in a postcard. Heaven on earth

reviews.title: Incontournable
reviews.text: Always as beautifulIf you look carefully, you can even park without having to pay (shh! The location is kept secret 😉)

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in Corsica!
reviews.text: This is definitely one of the most gorgeous beaches in Corsica - and one of the longest! Perfect turquoise water and white sand. There are a few bars on the beach where you get snacks (even a proper lunch but a bit pricey), ice cream and cocktails. In addition the beach is supervised by lifeguards. Tipp: be there early (at approximately 9:30 am) to get one of the rare parking spots near the beach! If you are too late you won’t get a parking spot and you have to walk down a road for 15 minutes (imagine walking the road uphill after the beach day)

reviews.title: Vacanza di 10 giorni in villa direttamente sulla spiaggia
reviews.text: Well equipped beach with 3 beach bars and rentals of all kinds. From kayaks to jet skis or a simple pedal boat or a dive.

reviews.title: Très bon restaurant
reviews.text: Very good restaurant where the preconceptions of mediocre beach restaurants disappear. Very careful dishes and magnificent setting.

reviews.title: Sopravvalutata
reviews.text: Considered one of the most beautiful beaches, even if in reality this is not exactly the case. Crowded, sea with algae and lots and lots of people!

reviews.title: Magnifique !!
reviews.text: Superb place. There is free parking, and the beach is large so you can go to several places. Further south, at the junction with Tamariciu beach you will find the most famous umbrella pine totem in Corsica (it was cut down in December 2019).

reviews.title: Un peu déçue
reviews.text: Yes, perfect turquoise water and fine white sand but very large beach with lots of people, water not that warm, a little disappointed I expected better

reviews.title: Mare cristallino
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of going to this beach the first day I arrived in Corsica. Very beautiful, except in some places where there was a bit of algae. Very salty water, it almost burns the skin since it is. Recommended.

reviews.title: Une des plus belles
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach with free or paid parking with shower, lots of people on the left part of the beach in summer, but more space and fewer people on the right part..follow signs for KALLISTE diving and restaurant at Chez Pierre.

reviews.title: Superbe!
reviews.text: Beautiful fine sand beach, with magnificent straw huts for lunch. We've been on foot for quite a long time. Transparent water. To do.

reviews.title: Ne cherchez plus !
reviews.text: One word: dream! A magnificent place, clear and transparent water. The beach is very clean. A place that we recommend with our eyes closed!

reviews.title: Mare azzurro e spiaggia bianca
reviews.text: Enchanting beach of fine sand with a wonderful turquoise sea. I recommend booking sunbeds days in advance in August because there are few.

reviews.title: Bella e comoda con i bambini
reviews.text: The beach is long and the sea is very beautiful with the seabed sloping gently. Parking is free and very close to the beach.

reviews.title: Journée plage
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach with turquoise water. No difficulty in accessing it (free parking but come early otherwise other paid parking lots at 3.50 for the day, close to the beach). Negative point: a lot of people on the sand and therefore little space already at 11 a.m.

reviews.title: A ne pas rater
reviews.text: A magnificent beach, translucent water and turquoise backgrounds. Don't forget your masks and snorkels: there are plenty of fish! Paid parking (€5 cash required)

reviews.title: La plus belle plage du sud de la corse
reviews.text: This set of beaches is incredible. They are all more beautiful than the others. A must do! We are less crowded there than on Santa Giulia...

reviews.title: Affollata
reviews.text: It is always very beautiful, especially in the afternoon the water turns blue and is fantastic. The sand looks like that of the Caribbean. It's very crowded so be careful in a Covid period like this.

reviews.title: Superbes
reviews.text: Superb beaches, coves, turquoise and warm waters, huts Plan a budget for parking and fins, snorkel masks

reviews.title: Tres belle plage
reviews.text: Beautiful beach: fine sand and turquoise water Gentle slope ideal with children And a bar to refresh yourself and buy ice cream which is rare in Corsica. Difficult to park.

reviews.title: Bellissima e poco affollata
reviews.text: A beach that has nothing to envy of the nearby Santa Giulia, Palombaggia is a real paradise, without overcrowding you can enjoy a beautiful day at the seaside with Caribbean water full of little fish.

reviews.title: Belle plage mais surévaluée
reviews.text: Pretty beach but unfortunately crowded and overpriced, despite free parking nearby. There are many nicer beaches in Corsica, with fewer people.

reviews.title: Plage sympa
reviews.text: A pretty beach with very little room to place your towel because there are many deckchairs and parasols on private beaches

reviews.title: après midi plage aout 2020
reviews.text: A pretty beach with very beautiful trees, but spoiled by private restaurants and private beaches, lots of people, boats, far from being the most beautiful in Corsica.

reviews.title: Formidable
reviews.text: Superb beautiful beach, we reserved the private beach of Palm Beach Palombaggia and we ate at the restaurant of the same name, a wonderful day spent with friends whether on the white sand or at a table at the restaurant 👌👌

reviews.title: Palombaggia
reviews.text: Nice panoramic road to get to the beach although a bit of traffic.  Wide beach and clean sea. Paid parking to access

reviews.title: Belle plage
reviews.text: Beach lined with umbrella pines, fine sand, turquoise water, magnificent! Paid parking in a shaded location.

reviews.title: Journée plage
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, although very busy! It is better to arrive early.... and not get stuck for parking...

reviews.title: Plage magnifique
reviews.text: We stayed for an afternoon on this beach with a young puppy. It is one of the most beautiful beaches in Corsica. The setting is splendid. There is a light wind which is pleasant in this heat.

reviews.title: Très belle plage
reviews.text: Despite the crowds and the boats, no buildings to distort the beach which remains in a setting of wild nature. Very good with children, in fact there are a majority of families there. Very beautiful beach, definitely worth experiencing.

reviews.title: Bof
reviews.text: The beach is long but not wide; lots of people. Watch out for bees and mosquitoes at the end of the afternoon.

reviews.title: Plage exceptionnelle mais parking inaccessible
reviews.text: This beach is exceptional but it is a shame that the parking lot is inaccessible due to lack of sufficient spaces. After several kilometers traveled, not being able to access one of the most beautiful beaches on the island of beauty is very frustrating.

reviews.title: sans plus
reviews.text: too many people few places to put your towel too touristy there are such beautiful beaches and many fewer people restaurants on the beach very expensive

reviews.title: Spiaggia top
reviews.text: I confirm one of the best beaches in Corsica. Everything positive that the reviews say is true: crystal clear sea, fine sand.. narrow but long, shallow seabed, little seaweed, there are establishments for those who want non-invasive comfort with the view. Lots of people but also lots of space!

reviews.title: Plus jamais
reviews.text: The restaurants have taken up too much space on this coastline. There is almost no sand left, it's a real shame. Feels like you're on a beach in Cannes!!! To avoid!!!

reviews.title: Magnifique !!!
reviews.text: Superb beach, easy to access with young children (11 months for us). The water is splendid and the white sand is so beautiful. Be careful!!! Some car parks are paid while others right next to them are free! We must be vigilant. On the other hand, it is better to go there early in the morning to enjoy it because from 11:00 a.m., the place is totally crowded and it can become unpleasant, people pile on top of each other... We had a great time there and were able to admire our fish friends from 8:30 a.m. to 11:00 a.m.

reviews.title: Pretty beach
reviews.text: Very nice and picturesque,  but busy. Parking can be an issue. Difficult to get a table at the resto.

reviews.title: Parfait ❤
reviews.text: Ideal beach, white sand, turquoise water, pine trees, rocks, what more could you ask for? Happiness is here 👌👍

reviews.title: Eau limpide mais beaucoup de monde
reviews.text: Disappointed with the place, it is very difficult to park, the beach may be very long but there are a lot of people, the water is clear but no fish.

reviews.title: Très beau
reviews.text: A little overrated, legendary beach but a little too built, too bad... the pine in the photos was cut down during a storm, beach to definitely visit

reviews.title: Bel endroit
reviews.text: Magnificent beach but very busy depending on the location. Go to a place called I Pini to access free parking and a slightly less busy place. You will find Julien's hut to drink a mojito and eat a croque croque-monsieur with ease.

reviews.title: Plage Splendide !!!
reviews.text: It has become my favorite beach!!! For its turquoise, transparent water and magnificent landscape! For young children or couples this place is perfect!

reviews.title: Bella spiaggia di sabbia fine
reviews.text: The Palombaggia beach is very long and even in the heart of August we didn't find too many people which is very pleasant. The water is crystal clear and a very light blue because the sand is white and fine. The only flaw is having closed off all access to the pine forest that runs along the beautiful Palombaggia with barbed iron. There are some private villas set in the pine forest and you can see that this splendid green nature... has become the prerogative of a few wealthy people and therefore you can enjoy the beach and the sea but not the shade of the beautiful pine trees. If you will stay for a long time it is better to bring an umbrella.

reviews.title: Un paradis
reviews.text: Magnificent beach, the most beautiful in the south of Corsica, I also particularly recommend the private beach of PalmBeach (Top!!!)

reviews.title: Bellissima
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, very ventilated white sand and accessible to dogs, the only thing is that with animals there is a specially reserved area where they can enter the water! otherwise Top!

reviews.title: Magnifique... mais victime de son succès
reviews.text: The beach is truly magnificent. It is large with fine sand and turquoise water. Free parking on Saturdays. On the other hand, a lot of people in August...

reviews.title: De loin la plus belle plage de corse
reviews.text: Turquoise waters and a huge beach Some nice restaurants by the sea A walk on the beach to do early in the morning or at the end of the day

reviews.title: Top
reviews.text: We loved it even though it was a little crowded. Ideal with children and snorkel mask. Paid parking unless you park on the street

reviews.title: Décevant
reviews.text: Very small beach and too many people. It is indeed beautiful but not at all peaceful. There are many other nicer beaches to see.

reviews.title: Jolie plage mais trop de monde
reviews.text: It's a pretty beach, the water is magnificent but much too touristy. We took a detour to go there anyway, but hey.. The beach is not maintained, the people are stuck together, it's average. The setting, however, is sublime, the view is magnificent, the beach is long, it's worth seeing once... for us, not two.

reviews.title: Una della spiagge più belle della Corsica
reviews.text: Exceptional, white sand, crystal clear water. Truly enchanting. It is accessed from a shady pine forest and it is not difficult to park nearby except in the busiest periods. The beach is almost entirely free except for a few establishments with attached restaurants.

reviews.title: Sable fin et eau turquoise
reviews.text: The sea is magnificent. Clear, turquoise waters. A real little paradise. Downsides: narrow and very busy beach. Paid parking: €20 for one and €30 for another. Deductible parking rate if you eat at the restaurant. Otherwise, park up along the road and walk a bit.

reviews.title: Sublime
reviews.text: Sublime beach, transparent sea, umbrella pines in the background. Some private beaches. To see!

reviews.title: Magique
reviews.text: Very very good beach with its turquoise and rocky water. Gorgeous ! Its white sand dazzles your eyes. No need to go to Tahiti to dream!

reviews.title: Belle plage (comme tout le monde le sait), MAIS...
reviews.text: Lots of people. Plan to go there early in the morning. Furthermore, the beach is not very wide, its size has been reduced by half in 20 years due to rising water levels (global warming, etc.), and the most accessible parking lot is *monstrously* expensive (€20 per space!). In short, a must during a trip to Corsica, but in the long run prefer quieter beaches.

reviews.title: Magique
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach 🏖 Breathtakingly blue...Don't hesitate to book a table at Playa Baggia...

reviews.title: Très agréable, belle eau, grand parking
reviews.text: We enjoyed Palombaggia this summer, with a one-year-old baby, in the shade of a rock, at the end of the day. We recommend the evening, swimming is very pleasant!

reviews.title: Une plage de rêve
reviews.text: Palombaggia: a dream beach with white sand and crystal clear water... don't miss the little walk to the neighboring beach of Tamaricciu.... with a small shaded passage and a small intermediate beach with large smooth rocks-pebbles... a little paradise!

reviews.title: Sublime
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach. Magnificent decorations. Very long beach. Easy place even with family. Not to be missed

reviews.title: Beau que sur les cartes postales
reviews.text: Impossible to set foot on this supposedly heavenly beach. A crazy world certainly due to its reputation... Scrap metal spikes in the water to hang paddles that you can't even see. A palliote with your feet in the water is good but with a passage it is perhaps better... Activities that you see on the internet not present on site... Anyway, if you want to relax this is not the place to go, especially with the many other beautiful beaches on our island.

reviews.title: A MUST
reviews.text: For us, this is the most beautiful beach in Europe. Cristal clear water, fine white sands, and - if you walk a bit away from the crowds that glue together close to the parking lots - with enough space for you and your family to spend a beautiful quiet day at the beach. Attention though: there is not a lot of shadow, one or two sunshades are mandatory!

reviews.title: Wat een bijzonder en heerlijk strandje!
reviews.text: We drove here from Porte Vecchio at sunset, around 6 pm. That was perfect. The sunset is amazing and the crowds are gone. Parking and chilling and eating good food: it's all possible. Take your wallet with you when you eat on the beach! We thought it was more than worth it!

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: Fantastic beach worth a visit. In August, very crowded, parking is almost impossible. Don't give up and go there.

reviews.title: nel 2020, a mio giudizio, la migliore
reviews.text: It is always a high level competition between Palombaggia, Santa Giuglia, Rondinara and Sperone. This year in my opinion, Palombaggia has something more. Definitely perfect water for everyone, from snorkelers to younger children. Very large, with an obvious possibility of "distancing", unlike Santa Giulia, and certainly well served. Fundamental note, if you follow the road from Portovecchio along the route de Piccovagia clockwise, the first detour to the beach takes you to the car park in the northern part. Which is free.. ;-)

reviews.title: Magnifique!
reviews.text: Very nice clean beach. Fine white sand, crystal clear waters... close your eyes, you are in Corsica! Despite the crowds, we found a place while respecting the distances.

reviews.title: Plage mythique
reviews.text: Very nice place, a little crowded in high season. This year we chose to spend some time there during the sunset, very nice!

reviews.title: Toller, sauberer Strand
reviews.text: Clean, well-maintained beach with dining options. White sand with crystal clear water. Easily accessible by car and with parking facilities.

reviews.title: Jolie plage
reviews.text: Very pretty beach, transparent water but a little too overrated compared to the others on the island. However, it remains a magnificent beach.

reviews.title: La fameuse plage
reviews.text: At 8 a.m. calm. Calm, clean and translucent water.  Walking distance so perfect for the children. Mérite sa réputation

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach. The water is beautiful, very clean with activities if you want. Easy to access.

reviews.title: Cuisine de qualité avec vue exceptionnelle
reviews.text: All the dishes are of excellent quality with generous portions.!! A great time on family vacation.

reviews.title: Sempre stupenda e la consiglio vivamente a chi va in Corsica
reviews.text: Wonderful fine sandy beach with a wonderful turquoise sea, Cala di Lume in the center of the bay, not even very crowded!

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: We are amazed...the water is crystal clear...fish surround us...a few people but nothing surprising.A beach to see and see again!

reviews.title: Splendide
reviews.text: Paid parking €4 to access this famous beach (July 2020 price). Very beautiful but there are so many other beaches as pretty, or even prettier, and with free access. It’s the selfie beach 😜. And fame has a price.🙃

reviews.title: Le paradis
reviews.text: My favorite! No seaweed, several huts to drink a coffee or a Pietra....turquoise water, paradise....

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: Wonderful location, we stayed all day, dream bay with clear, crystalline water. The second year that I return to this island and I confirm, Palombaggia is one of the most beautiful beaches in Corsica, especially if visited early in the morning. (the fish come closer and swim with you!) The only flaw is 4.50 Euros for 0.5l of water and 22 Euros for a salad at the bar of one of the wooden bars near the beach, definitely too much. If you happen to be near Porto Vecchio, spend a day on this magnificent beach because it's absolutely worth it, but watch out for the prices!

reviews.title: Bruyante et surpeuplée
reviews.text: Reading the positive comments I was so excited to discover it but once I got there: what a disappointment! Narrow, dirty, crowded, noisy, so many boats moored that we couldn't see the sea... in short, certainly a victim of its success, it has lost all its charm... First and last time for us. Damage !

reviews.title: Très belle plage
reviews.text: Very beautiful sandy beach. Magnificent view. Very well known, probably too well known... lots of people. Not necessarily better in the end than other lesser known beaches.

reviews.title: Superbe
reviews.text: The beach has two or three access points. On the east side you can park for 4 euros then access to the beach about 400 m away. Restaurant also with private parking. The beach is long and magnificent with its turquoise colored and transparent waters. Not to be missed.

reviews.title: Plage de rêve
reviews.text: Turquoise waters for hundreds of meters. Clean waters. Beaches like in the tropics. One of the two most beautiful beaches in Corsica with Saleccia (near Saint Florent).

reviews.title: Sublime
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach, the water is turquoise, we had an excellent afternoon! There are also water activities like jet skiing, paddle boarding, and towed buoys!

reviews.title: Jolie plage
reviews.text: Nice beach, pretty but lots of people. The car park near the beach being full we had to park at the top of the access road, go far for young children.

reviews.title: Belle Plage de Sable
reviews.text: Beautiful fine sand beach without any particular risk for swimming for children, magnificent water colors in July

reviews.title: Belle plage
reviews.text: A great discovery that deserves its good reputation! Clear water... you'd think you were in the Caribbean!

reviews.title: Plage de rêve
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with a little shade, white sand, transparent, warm water... ideal for hot summer days. Not too many people at this particular time.

reviews.title: Venir tôt
reviews.text: Magnificent beach, we can't say the opposite, but you have to come early because there are a lot of people.....Paid parking but like all the beaches in the surrounding area....

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: The beach lives up to its reputation as one of the best in Europe.....crystal clear water, white sands, easy access.....highly recommended!

reviews.title: Journée de rêve
reviews.text: Exceptional family day on the private beach of Palmbeach, a top-notch team, I highly recommend......

reviews.title: Bellissima
reviews.text: Fantastic beach and sea. Very clean sea, much better than the Caribbean, warm water, numerous fish near the rocks. What can I say? A real paradise

reviews.title: Another nice beach
reviews.text: Very long beach, with several entrances, some close to the beach, others probably quite a walk. We were late, so could park (for free) very close, however it looked like it had been quite a lot more busy and therefore longer walks). Beach is sandy, white, water blue and warm, like most Corsican beaches.

reviews.title: Très beau
reviews.text: Renowned for being one of the most beautiful beaches, very busy, but magnificent water, very good beach restaurants, few free places unless you walk. Go further to the tamaricciu coast

reviews.title: Bof bof bof
reviews.text: After having tried several times to get someone online to find out and booked... The only more than average contact was a complicated text message... Without really a response... Arrived on site (coming from Bastia) friendly staff but clearly at the service of the regulars... We take the money where it is..... Although I'm not bad... At this level but haven't known enough... In fact we were coming for a day. In short, I wouldn't come back... This won't change the situation in any way. attendance...But clearly the direct competitor is much more human (Palm....)See my published opinion 😊😊

reviews.title: Parfait
reviews.text: Magnificent white sand beach with crystal clear sea... what could be better? However quite difficult to park by car, but hey it's quickly forgotten...

reviews.title: Trop snob pour moi
reviews.text: Too many thongs kill the thong! However, nature takes over. I prefer the wilder coast of Taramicciu, right next door.

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: Magnificent beach as I like: fine sand, flat bottom, transparent water, no waves, pine trees along the beach.... But lots of people despite the small number of tourists this year. You can park for free along the road. Arriving on the beach, going left, just after the location of the famous umbrella pine which has now disappeared, there is a more intimate shaded area, the water is warmer but the sand is coarser.

reviews.title: Belle plage
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, but I preferred Rondinara or Santa Giulia. They are more beautiful. Way too many people. And a hassle to get there and park... you have to go there early and leave after 6 p.m. I think.

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: We have several beaches in southern Corsica and this one is truly magnificent. Great beach with plenty of room and the water is so beautiful. The only negative side is that since the beach is very busy, parking is rather complicated.

reviews.title: Très déçu en saison
reviews.text: We enjoyed Palombaggia a few years ago, alone at 8 a.m. We returned this year at the end of the morning and were very disappointed. We much prefer the more intimate beaches of the Propriano region (Porto Polo, Campomoro...)

reviews.title: Très belle plage
reviews.text: Great place. Free parking. We arrived around 10 a.m. Not many people in the (free) parking lot. Several cabins to eat or have a drink. Clean beach.

reviews.title: très belle plage
reviews.text: the beach is easy to access. Parking is free and shaded under the pines and pine forest. possibility of having lunch on site (bar-restaurant) and doing activities of all kinds: diving, paddle, ...

reviews.title: Aucun acte de bienveillance pour les femmes enceintes
reviews.text: Extremely unhappy.... My pregnant wife being restricted in her diet. We were forbidden to have a panini at the table while a family (father and child) was entitled to have it knowing that it is supposedly forbidden..... So we don't care about pregnant women?????.....

reviews.title: Magnifique...compliqué pour se garer
reviews.text: No need to contradict everything that is said. The beach is magnificent, the water is crystal clear, without any algae, the sand is very clean.  The only downside is parking. You just have to have a little luck, that's all.

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: It is certainly one of the most beautiful beaches on the island. White sand and clear water. Complicated access, there is a very narrow descent by car and complicated parking. But if you have a rental car with super cover then don't hesitate to go as far as possible.

The beach is certainly a little narrow but allows the space to be slightly restricted, therefore tourists. It is also very well maintained and very clean. The not-so-shy fish come and peck at the legs when launching into the water and amuse young people and adults alike! There are also several restaurants along the beach which gives an air of paradise to this already magnificent beach. Several paid parking lots (inexpensive for the day, around 3-5€) are located upstream of the beach and are connected directly by Corsican backwoods paths to the beach. Variety of landscapes guaranteed!

reviews.title: Belle plage
reviews.text: A superb beach, turquoise water, paradise. Favor the part on the right facing the sea, me of aquatic grass....To see, one of the most beautiful beaches in Southern Corsica

reviews.title: Spiaggiane bianco
reviews.text: A very beautiful beach, on the other hand, its fame has been confirmed and it paid off for the hard work we did on the bike! 😊

reviews.title: Magnifique plage
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches, crystal clear water, little to see the fish... idyllic setting... children are happy, feet away... magnificent landscapes...

reviews.title: Spiaggia bella ma affollata
reviews.text: Very large and beautiful beach with sand, also ideal for walking. There are also restaurants and bars that offer sunbeds (not at low prices). In August very very crowded.

reviews.title: Nefasto
reviews.text: More than 40 minutes of waiting Not an apology Not a detail Badly educated waiters To forget Place not to return

reviews.title: Le paradis
reviews.text: Free parking in Les Pains Translucent water with an ideal temperature Almost fine sand Fish to contemplate

reviews.title: un petit paradis envahi par la foule en juillet/août
reviews.text: Only one question: why go to Seychelles (just replace the coconut trees with pine trees)

reviews.title: Paradisiaque
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach in Corsica, ideal for swimming and admiring a dream landscape. Plan to arrive early in the morning in August to have a place for the car and the towel!

reviews.title: Une des plus belles plages de Corse
reviews.text: Magnificent beach, crystal clear waters, white sand. One of the most beautiful beaches in Corsica, and therefore in Europe. Worth seeing despite the crowds at certain times, and the difficulty of parking. Outside of the very high season it is a paradise.

reviews.title: Playas más bonitas en el oeste
reviews.text: Everyone told us that we absolutely had to go to this beach, which along with Santa Giulia was the best beach in Corsica. Although long and beautiful due to the color of the water and because it is surrounded by pine trees, it has a meter and a half of sand and is colonized by tourists and beach bars of monstrous size. In the western part of the island there are much more impressive beaches, with much more space of sand and less congested.

reviews.title: belle plage
reviews.text: too bad everyone is there to make money but in any case this beach deserves to be seen preferably in the morning until 11 a.m. or in the evening after 5 p.m.

reviews.title: Superbe
reviews.text: Better to get there early. Magnificent beach. White sand, turquoise water. Free parking which is very nice.

reviews.title: Superbe plage !
reviews.text: Big, clean, and beautiful! Several paid parking lots: €5 Possibility of parking on the side of the road.

reviews.title: Magnifique
reviews.text: If you only have one beach to see in your program, don't miss this one! White sand, turquoise water, plenty of room to spread out your towel without being on top of each other. The wild side is preserved, restaurants and boats are not spread out all along this superb beach. Go there and admire!!!

reviews.title: Toujours aussi top! (30/08/19)
reviews.text: This beach is still beautiful (especially when the masses of tourists have left!) Small preference for the first cove furthest south with its granite blocks which also allow you to make a few 5m jumps in complete safety!
